definition_zh: 蛙；青蛙；（马蹄后部的）蹄叉
definition_en: a small tailless amphibian with long hind legs for jumping that lives both in water and on land
core_image: 蹲在荷叶上鼓着眼睛、随时弹跳出去的小青蛙
scene: 雨后的池塘边一片湿润，草叶上还挂着水珠。A green frog leaped off the lily pad and disappeared into the water with a splash.
sceneCN: 这里 frog 是「青蛙」（第 1 个义项：水陆两栖的小动物）；句意为一只绿蛙从睡莲叶上跳起，扑通一声消失在水里。

collocations.zh: 温水煮蛙（比喻慢慢恶化而不察觉）

derivatives.zh: 由名词 frog 加形容词后缀 -y 构成，义为「青蛙似的；（嗓音）沙哑的」
复合词 frog + man，义为「蛙人；水下作业潜水员」

senses.title: The small jumping amphibian
senses.definition: a small tailless amphibian that swims and leaps, starting life as a tadpole
senses.definitionCN: 一种无尾两栖小动物，会游泳会跳跃，幼体是蝌蚪
senses.example: The frog caught a fly with its long tongue.
senses.exampleCN: 青蛙用长舌头捕住了一只苍蝇。
senses.why: The word names the animal itself, so the sense grows straight out of the picture of a leaping pond creature.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名的就是动物本身，因此义项直接从「池塘里会弹跳的小生物」这一画面长出来。

senses.title: The spongy part of a horse's hoof
senses.definition: the soft V-shaped structure on the underside of a horse's hoof
senses.definitionCN: 马蹄底面柔软的 V 形结构，起减震作用
senses.example: The farrier cleaned the frog of the horse's hoof.
senses.exampleCN: 蹄铁匠清理了马蹄的蹄叉。
senses.why: The shape and springiness of this part reminded people of the animal, so the image of the frog was transferred to the hoof.
senses.whyCN: 这个部位的样子和弹性让人联想到青蛙，于是把「青蛙」的形象转移到了马蹄上，形成了这一专业义项。

senses.title: The frog-shaped fastener for clothing
senses.definition: an ornamental braided fastening, especially on Chinese-style coats
senses.definitionCN: 中式服装上用绳编织成的盘扣，形似青蛙
senses.example: The silk jacket closed with a row of frogs down the front.
senses.exampleCN: 这件丝质外套前襟用一排盘扣系合。
senses.why: Because the braided loops resemble a crouching frog, makers borrowed the animal's name for the fastener.
senses.whyCN: 因为编织的环扣形似蹲着的青蛙，制衣者借用了动物的名字来称呼这种扣件。

intro.en: Frog goes back to Old English, and its ultimate origin is uncertain, though many scholars connect it to words meaning to hop or croak.
intro.cn: frog 可追溯到古英语，其最终来源不确定，但许多学者把它与表示「跳、蛙鸣」的词联系起来。

items.en: Old English frogga and forsc named the pond amphibian.
items.cn: 古英语 frogga 与 forsc 用来指池塘里的两栖动物。

items.en: It belongs to a Germanic family of frog words, though no certain common root has been reconstructed.
items.cn: 它属于日耳曼语系里指蛙的一族词，但尚未重构出确定的共同词根。

items.en: Some scholars link it to an Indo-European base meaning to hop; others see it as imitative of the croaking sound.
items.cn: 一些学者把它与意为「跳跃」的印欧词基相联；另一些认为它是对蛙鸣声的拟声。

items.en: Middle English frogge carried both the animal sense and, later, the fastener sense.
items.cn: 中古英语 frogge 既指动物，后来也发展出扣件义。

items.en: Modern English keeps the animal as the core sense and adds hoof and clothing uses.
items.cn: 现代英语以动物义为核心，并发展出马蹄与服装的专业用法。

note.en: Frog is easy to confuse with several short animal and sound words.
note.cn: frog 容易和一些短小的动物词、拟声词混淆。

entries.definition: thick cloud of water droplets near the ground
entries.definitionCN: 雾；只是拼写与 frog 相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a dress, especially for a woman or girl
entries.definitionCN: 连衣裙；与 frog 拼写相近但毫无同源关系

entries.definition: a similar amphibian with a drier, warty body
entries.definitionCN: 蟾蜍；与青蛙同类但外形更干、有疣，词源独立

entries.definition: the larva of a frog or toad that lives in water
entries.definitionCN: 蝌蚪；蛙的幼体，与 frog 同属生活史链条

entries.definition: an amphibian of the same order, usually land-dwelling
entries.definitionCN: 蟾蜍；与 frog 同目不同科，常栖陆地

entries.definition: a small amphibian with a lizard-like tail
entries.definitionCN: 蝾螈；同为两栖动物但有尾巴，与 frog 相区分

normalIntro.en: Five real hooks for remembering frog.
normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实词形与用法的 frog 记忆钩子。

normal.en: Frog shares its first letters with from, and the frog always leaps away from where it sat.
normal.cn: frog 的开头与 from 相同，青蛙总是从蹲着的地方弹跳离开。

normal.en: The phrase frog in one's throat literally puts a frog in your voice box.
normal.cn: 短语 frog in one's throat 字面是青蛙卡在喉咙，对应嗓子沙哑。

normal.en: A tadpole grows into a frog, so learn the two words as one life chain.
normal.cn: 蝌蚪长成青蛙，把 tadpole 与 frog 当作一条生命链来记。

normal.en: The adjective froggy uses the suffix -y to turn the animal into a quality.
normal.cn: 形容词 froggy 用后缀 -y 把动物名变成性质词。

normal.en: The fairy tale of the frog prince turns this word into a story hook.
normal.cn: 青蛙王子的童话把这个词变成了故事钩子。

abstract.en: Picture a frog crouching on a lily pad, eyes bulging, ready to spring.
abstract.cn: 想象一只青蛙蹲在睡莲叶上，鼓着眼睛蓄势待发。

abstract.en: Hear the two-beat croak, which almost repeats the word's own rhythm.
abstract.cn: 听那两拍蛙鸣，节奏几乎就是这个词本身的节奏。

abstract.en: Trace the arc of its leap, a curved line like a swelling letter.
abstract.cn: 描出它跳跃的弧线，像鼓起的字母曲线。

examples.en: A frog sat on the lily pad all afternoon.
examples.cn: 一只青蛙在睡莲叶上待了一下午。

examples.en: The children caught frogs by the pond and let them go.
examples.cn: 孩子们在池塘边捉了青蛙又放了。

examples.en: He cleared his throat, as if there were a frog in his throat.
examples.cn: 他清了清嗓子，像是有青蛙卡在喉咙里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「弗罗格」——青蛙先生姓弗罗格，蹲在池塘边呱呱叫。

root: 来源不确定：一般认为 frog 是古英语本土词，可能与表示「跳跃」的印欧词基有关，或为拟声词；无可靠的拉丁、希腊词根，不要强行拆解。

sensesIntro.en: The animal sense is the core; from it grow two figurative or specialized senses.
sensesIntro.cn: 动物义是核心；由它发展出马蹄与服装两个专业或比喻义项。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small leaping amphibian by the pond
core.cn: 核心意象：池塘边会弹跳的小两栖动物

branches.cn: 由形状引出的联想用法

intro.en: Frog is a short native word, so its word-building power comes from suffixes and compounds.
intro.cn: frog 是简短的本土词，构词能力主要体现在后缀与复合词上。

latinIntro.en: There are no Latin relatives because the word is Germanic and of uncertain origin.
latinIntro.cn: frog 属日耳曼语系且来源不确定，没有拉丁同源词。

items.meaning: like a frog; (of a voice) hoarse
items.example: He sounded froggy after the game.
items.exampleCN: 比赛后他的嗓音沙哑。

items.example: A muddy, froggy pond attracted herons.
items.exampleCN: 泥泞多蛙的池塘引来苍鹭。

items.meaning: away, back (seen in from and fro)
items.meaningCN: 离去；向后（见于 from 与 to and fro）
items.example: She walked to and fro along the shore.
items.exampleCN: 她沿着岸边来回走。

items.example: Boats shuttled to and fro on the river.
items.exampleCN: 小船在河上来回穿梭。

items.meaning: a frog that lives in trees
items.meaningCN: 树蛙；栖息在树上的蛙类
items.example: A tiny tree frog clung to a leaf.
items.exampleCN: 一只小树蛙紧贴在叶片上。

items.example: Bullfrogs bellowed after dark.
items.exampleCN: 天黑后牛蛙低吼起来。

items.meaning: a diver equipped for underwater work
items.example: The frogman checked the hull.
items.exampleCN: 蛙人检查了船体。

items.example: Each frogman wore a sealed suit.
items.exampleCN: 每名蛙人都穿着密封潜水服。

items.example: Tadpoles wriggled in the shallows.
items.exampleCN: 蝌蚪在浅水区扭动。

derivatives.zh: 青蛙似的；沙哑的

definition_zh: 从；来自；由于；与……（不同、区别开）
definition_en: used to show the starting point, source, origin, cause, or separation in space, time, or manner
core_image: 一条起点清晰、向外延伸的路径：人、物或时间从某处出发
scene: 清晨的火车站台上，广播报着班次。The morning train to Hangzhou departs from platform six, so we still have time for coffee.
sceneCN: 这里 from 表示「从……出发」（第 1 个义项：起点）；句意为开往杭州的早班车从六号站台发车，我们还来得及喝杯咖啡。

derivatives.zh: 与 from 同源的日耳曼词，义为「向前；向外」，语义偏移为方向副词
方向后缀 -ward 构成的副词，义为「朝家的方向」，与 from 的起点语义互补

senses.title: A starting point in space
senses.definition: used to show the place where movement or distance begins
senses.definitionCN: 表示移动或距离开始的地方
senses.example: She walks to school from her grandmother's house.
senses.exampleCN: 她从奶奶家步行去学校。
senses.why: The core picture is a path with a clear origin; the preposition names that origin point.
senses.whyCN: 核心画面是一条有明确起点的路径；介词的功能就是标出那个起点。

senses.title: A starting point in time
senses.definition: used to show when something begins
senses.definitionCN: 表示某事开始的时间点
senses.example: The shop is open from nine in the morning.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店从早上九点开始营业。
senses.why: Time is imagined as a line, so the same origin-point idea moves from space onto the time line.
senses.whyCN: 时间被想象成一条线，于是「起点」的空间概念迁移到了时间线上。

senses.title: Source or origin
senses.definition: used to show where something comes, is sent, or is obtained
senses.definitionCN: 表示某物来自哪里、由谁寄出或从何处取得
senses.example: This letter is from my pen friend in Canada.
senses.exampleCN: 这封信来自我加拿大的笔友。
senses.why: Things travel like people do; the origin of a thing is treated as its starting point.
senses.whyCN: 物的流动像人的移动一样，物的来源被当作它的出发点来表述。

senses.title: Cause or reason
senses.definition: used to show the cause of a feeling, state, or result
senses.definitionCN: 表示情感、状态或结果的原因
senses.example: He trembled from cold and fear.
senses.exampleCN: 他因寒冷和恐惧而发抖。
senses.why: A cause is imagined as the source from which a state flows out, reusing the origin image.
senses.whyCN: 原因被想象成状态流出的源头，复用「来源」的画面。

senses.title: Raw material
senses.definition: used to show the material something is made of
senses.definitionCN: 表示制成某物所用的材料
senses.example: Paper is made from bamboo and rags in some villages.
senses.exampleCN: 在一些村庄，纸是用竹子和破布做的。
senses.why: The material is the origin of the finished thing, so from marks what the object started as.
senses.whyCN: 原料是成品的来源，因此 from 标记物品最初由什么开始。

senses.title: Separation or difference
senses.definition: used to show that two things are kept apart or are different
senses.definitionCN: 表示两事物被隔开或彼此不同
senses.example: Can you tell real pearls from false ones?
senses.exampleCN: 你能分辨真珍珠与假珍珠吗？
senses.why: To tell one thing from another is to pull them apart at a shared point, reusing the departure image.
senses.whyCN: 区分两者就是在共同点上把它们拉开，复用「离开起点」的画面。

intro.en: From is one of the oldest function words in English, a native preposition whose history is fully Germanic.
intro.cn: from 是英语最古老的功能词之一，是纯日耳曼语系的本土介词。

items.en: A reconstructed Germanic adverb and preposition *fr- meant away from, forward.
items.cn: 重构的日耳曼语副词兼介词 *fr- 表示「离开、向前」。

items.en: Old English fram meant from, forward, and also brave as an adjective.
items.cn: 古英语 fram 既表示「从、向前」，作形容词时还表示「勇敢的」。

items.en: Closely related Old Norse frá reinforced the same preposition in northern speech.
items.cn: 同源的古诺斯语 frá 在北方口语中强化了这一介词。

items.en: Middle English from settled into the standard preposition of origin and separation.
items.cn: 中古英语 from 稳定为表示来源与分离的标准介词。

items.en: Modern English keeps all core uses: point of origin, source, cause, material, and difference.
items.cn: 现代英语保留了全部核心用法：起点、来源、原因、原料与区别。

note.en: From pairs with to, and its Germanic cousins share the same root.
note.cn: from 与 to 成对出现，它的日耳曼近亲词共享同一词根。

entries.definition: shape, or a document with blanks to fill
entries.definitionCN: 形状；表格；与 from 只是字母顺序不同，词源完全不同
向前；与 from 同出日耳曼词根，语义偏向方向
前面；拼写相近但来自拉丁语词根
……的；由（弱化的来源义）；与 from 的原料义有分工
从……里面出来；与 from 重叠但强调由内向外

entries.definition: from a point in time up to now
entries.definitionCN: 自……以来；只用于时间，不用于空间起点

normalIntro.en: Five grounded hooks for the preposition from.
normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实用法的介词 from 记忆钩子。

normal.en: From shares the Germanic fr- head that also moves forward in forth and fro.
normal.cn: from 与 forth、fro 共享日耳曼词头 fr-，都带着「离开、向前」的意味。

normal.en: The collocation from now on is the most frequent, so anchor all others to it.
normal.cn: 搭配 from now on 最常用，先把其他用法都挂在它上面。

normal.en: Tell A from B means pulling A away from B until they are separate.
normal.cn: tell A from B 就是把 A 从 B 身边拉开，直到两者分开。

normal.en: Made from signals a changed material, while made of keeps the material visible.
normal.cn: made from 表示原料已变形，made of 表示材质仍可辨认。

normal.en: From and to form a fixed pair: origin against endpoint.
normal.cn: from 与 to 是固定搭档：起点对终点。

abstract.en: See the exact moment an arrow leaves the bowstring: that point is from.
abstract.cn: 想象箭离弦的一瞬：那个点就是 from。

abstract.en: Treat time as a river; from is where you step in.
abstract.cn: 把时间想成河流，from 是你下水的地点。

abstract.en: Separating two tangled ropes at a knot mirrors telling one thing from another.
abstract.cn: 在绳结处分开两根缠绳，正如区分两件事物。

examples.en: The bus goes from the station to the airport.
examples.cn: 这班巴士从车站开往机场。

examples.en: She was tired from working all night.
examples.cn: 她因整夜工作而疲惫。

examples.en: Wine is made from grapes.
examples.cn: 葡萄酒由葡萄酿成。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「弗罗姆」——弗罗姆先生从弗罗姆镇来，人未到，from 先到。

root: 日耳曼本土词：一般认为来自原始日耳曼语 *fram（向前；离开），与古诺斯语 frá、英语 forth 同族；非拉丁、希腊来源。

sensesIntro.en: All senses share one image: a clear starting point from which things, people, time, or causes flow outward.
sensesIntro.cn: 所有义项共用一个画面：一个清晰的起点，人、物、时间或原因由此向外延展。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a path with a marked origin point
core.cn: 核心意象：标出起点的路径

branches.en: pulling apart from a shared point

intro.en: From itself takes no affixes, but its root family built several everyday words.
intro.cn: from 本身不接词缀，但它的词根族构成了多个日常词。

latinIntro.en: There are no Latin relatives: from is purely Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词：from 是纯日耳曼词。

items.example: She stepped forth into the light.
items.exampleCN: 她步入光亮之中。

items.example: He paced to and fro.
items.exampleCN: 他来回踱步。

items.example: Keep the medicine from children.
items.exampleCN: 把药放在儿童够不到的地方。

items.example: Old English fram once praised a bold warrior.
items.exampleCN: 古英语 fram 曾用于称赞勇士。

items.example: The old verb fremian shared the same root family.
items.exampleCN: 古动词 fremian 与其同根。

items.example: Flags swung to and fro in the wind.
items.exampleCN: 旗帜在风中来回摆动。

items.example: The family moved homeward at dusk.
items.exampleCN: 一家人黄昏时朝家走去。

items.example: The path runs homeward through the fields.
items.exampleCN: 这条路穿过田野通向家。

items.meaning: from a time up to now
items.meaningCN: 自……以来；与 from 分工于时间
items.example: I have known him since childhood.
items.exampleCN: 我从小就认识他。

definition_zh: 锋面；前线；正面；前部；表象；阵线；掩护；面向
definition_en: the forward part or face of something, a line of conflict, a public appearance, or the boundary between two air masses
core_image: 两种颜色的空气沿一道斜面相遇，暖的爬上去，冷的钻到底，交界处云带陡立
scene: 夜里有条界线悄悄扫过海岸，天亮时风向已经换了。A weak front passed the coast overnight without bringing rain.
sceneCN: 这里指「两个气团之间的倾斜交界」（第 1 个义项：冷暖气团相接的锋面）；句意为一条弱锋面夜里扫过海岸，却没有带来降雨。图中可辨识物件：倾斜的交界面、贴着海面的云带、转向的风向标、未落雨的码头。

pos.zh: 锋面；前线；正面；前部；表象；阵线

collocations.zh: 在几条战线上；在多个方面

derivatives.zh: 锋面的；正面的
临街面；正面宽度
边境；前沿
前线；一线的
向前的

senses.title: The boundary between two air masses
senses.definition: the sloping interface where two air masses of different temperature and density meet
senses.definitionCN: 温度与密度不同的两个气团相接的倾斜界面
senses.example: A weak front passed the coast overnight without bringing rain.
senses.exampleCN: 一条弱锋面夜里扫过海岸，却没有带来降雨。
senses.why: The weather sense borrows the military image: two bodies of air meet as two armies do, along a line.
senses.whyCN: 气象义借用了军事意象：两团空气像两支军队一样，沿一条线相遇。

senses.title: The forward line in a conflict
senses.definition: the line or area where opposing armed forces are in contact
senses.definitionCN: 敌对武装力量发生接触的战线或区域
senses.example: Supplies reached the front only after dark.
senses.exampleCN: 补给在天黑之后才送抵前线。
senses.why: This is the oldest modern sense: the place where an army faces its opponent.
senses.whyCN: 这是该词最早的现代义：军队面对对手的地方。

senses.title: The forward face of an object
senses.definition: the part of a building, vehicle or body that faces forward
senses.definitionCN: 建筑、车辆或身体朝前的一面
senses.example: The front of the house faces the square.
senses.exampleCN: 房子的正面朝向广场。
senses.why: The word began as the forehead, so 'the face you present' is the original image.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指额头，因此「你呈现出的那一面」就是它本来的意象。

senses.title: A public appearance put on
senses.titleCN: 刻意做出给人看的样子
senses.definition: a manner or appearance adopted to hide one's real feelings or situation
senses.definitionCN: 为掩盖真实情感或处境而采取的举止或外表
senses.example: He put on a brave front for the family.
senses.exampleCN: 他在家人面前强作镇定。
senses.why: A face can be managed like a shop window, which is why the word means a display.
senses.whyCN: 脸可以像橱窗一样被布置，因此这个词有了「展示」的意思。

senses.title: A united political line
senses.definition: a coalition of groups acting together on a shared issue
senses.definitionCN: 就共同议题一致行动的团体联盟
senses.example: The parties formed a united front against the bill.
senses.exampleCN: 各党结成联合阵线反对该法案。
senses.why: Politics borrowed the battle line and turned it into an alliance.
senses.whyCN: 政治借用了战线，把它变成了一种联盟。

senses.title: One area of activity among several
senses.definition: a particular area in which effort, progress or attack is being made
senses.definitionCN: 投入努力、取得进展或发起攻势的某个特定领域
senses.example: The charity works on several fronts at once.
senses.exampleCN: 该慈善机构同时在多个方面开展工作。
senses.why: If a struggle has a line, it can have several lines, and each becomes a 'front'.
senses.whyCN: 如果一场斗争有一条线，就可以有多条线，每条都成为一个「方面」。

senses.title: A cover organisation
senses.definition: a business or group that hides the real activity behind it
senses.definitionCN: 在背后隐藏真实活动的商号或团体
senses.example: The warehouse was a front for the smuggling ring.
senses.exampleCN: 那家仓库是走私团伙的掩护。
senses.why: A front is what is shown; here the shown surface is deliberately false.
senses.whyCN: 该词本指被展示的一面；此处被展示的表面是故意虚假的。

senses.title: To face toward something
senses.definition: to have the front directed toward a place, as a building does
senses.definitionCN: 正面朝向某处，如建筑物那样
senses.example: The hotel fronts the harbour and the market.
senses.exampleCN: 这家酒店正面朝向港口与市场。
senses.why: The verb simply applies the noun's 'forward face' as a direction.
senses.whyCN: 该词本指被展示的一面；此处被展示的表面是故意虚假的。

intro.en: Front comes from Latin frons, frontis 'forehead, brow, front', through Old French front. The meteorological sense was added by the Norwegian school of forecasting in the early twentieth century.
intro.cn: front 经古法语 front 来自拉丁 frons, frontis「额头、眉、正面」。气象义由挪威预报学派在 20 世纪初加入。

items.en: Frons meant the forehead and, by extension, the face or the forward side of anything.
items.cn: frons 指额头，引申指面部或任何事物的朝前一面。

items.en: Old French front kept the military and architectural senses, and English borrowed it after the Norman period.
items.cn: 古法语 front 保留了军事与建筑义，英语在诺曼时期之后借入。

items.en: By the seventeenth century front meant the line where armies meet, and from there a collective political line.
items.cn: 到 17 世纪，front 指军队相接的战线，并由此引申为集体政治阵线。

items.en: In the 1910s and 1920s Bergen forecasters applied the military word to the boundary of two air masses, because it behaved like a battle line.
items.cn: 在 20 世纪一十至二十年代，卑尔根预报员把这个军事词用到两个气团的交界上，因为其行为像一条战线。

items.en: The derived adjective frontal and the compound frontal system followed, fixing the term in synoptic meteorology.
items.cn: 派生的形容词 frontal 与复合语 frontal system 随之出现，把该术语固定在天气学中。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date only): the earliest citation for the meteorological sense is given differently in different histories; the derivation from frons is not in doubt.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代）：气象义的最早书证在不同史著中记载不一；其出自 frons 的派生关系并无疑义。

note.en: Group one holds words derived from front that differ in meaning; group two holds words for a boundary or a displayed face.
note.cn: 第一组是由本词派生而含义不同的词；第二组是表示交界或展示面的词。

entries.definition: Front plus -al: of a front, as in frontal rain or a frontal lobe; it describes, it does not name the boundary.
entries.definitionCN: 由 front 加 -al：锋面的，如锋面雨或额叶；它作描述，不指交界本身。

entries.definition: Front plus -ier: a border between countries or the edge of what is known, not a weather front.
entries.definitionCN: 由 front 加 -ier：国家间的边境或已知领域的边缘，而非天气锋面。

entries.definition: Front plus -age: the width of a property along a street, a measurement rather than a face.
entries.definitionCN: 由 front 加 -age：产业沿街的正面宽度，是量度而非面。

entries.definition: Any line marking a limit; a front is a boundary, but boundary is far broader and not meteorological.
entries.definitionCN: 标记界限的任何线；锋面是一种边界，但 boundary 宽泛得多，且不属气象术语。

entries.definition: The front of a building, and figuratively a deceptive outward appearance; it matches the 'put on a front' sense only.
entries.definitionCN: 建筑的正面，比喻虚假的外表；只对应「装出样子」这一义项。

entries.definition: The leading part of an army or movement; it names the troops at the front, not the line itself.
entries.definitionCN: 军队或运动的最前部；指位于前方的部队，而非战线本身。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin frons, the real military line and the real Bergen extension.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁词源、真实的军事战线与真实的卑尔根延伸。

normal.en: Latin frons meant forehead, so a front is the face you turn to the world.
normal.cn: 拉丁 frons 指额头，因此 front 是你转向世界的那张脸。

normal.en: Armies meet at the front, and so do air masses.
normal.cn: 军队在前线相遇，气团也在锋面相遇。

normal.en: Fixed phrases split the senses: front line, put on a front, united front.
normal.cn: 固定搭配区分义项：前线、强作镇定、联合阵线。

normal.en: On several fronts turns one line into several areas of effort.
normal.cn: 「在几条战线」把一条线变成了多个努力领域。

normal.en: Frontal is the derived adjective used in meteorology.
normal.cn: frontal 是气象学中使用的派生形容词。

abstract.en: Picture a face held up like a shield while the person hides behind it.
abstract.cn: 想象一张像盾牌一样举起的脸，人藏在后面。

abstract.en: Picture two coloured liquids meeting along a tilted wall.
abstract.cn: 想象两种颜色的液体沿一道倾斜的墙相遇。

abstract.en: Picture a shop window that is all display and no shop.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇全是陈列、里面却没有店的橱窗。

examples.en: The front stalled over the mountains and rain persisted for days.
examples.cn: 锋面在山地上空停滞，降雨持续了数日。

examples.en: Reporters were kept well behind the front.
examples.cn: 记者被留在前线之后很远的地方。

examples.en: The charity is fighting on three fronts: housing, food and schooling.
examples.cn: 该慈善机构在住房、食物与教育三条战线上努力。

dict_mnemonic.text: 音近「弗龙特」——两军面对的那条线 → 前线、锋面、正面

root: 拉丁 frons, frontis「额头、眉、正面」，经古法语 front 进入英语；气象义为 20 世纪初卑尔根学派所加。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all turn on a forward face or a meeting line: weather boundary, battle line, building face, displayed manner, political alliance, area of effort, cover business and the verb of facing.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都围绕「朝前的一面」或「相接的线」：天气交界、战线、建筑正面、展示的举止、政治联盟、努力领域、掩护生意，以及面向的动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a face turned outward, and the line where that face meets another.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张朝外的脸，以及这张脸与另一者相接的线。

branches.en: THE LINE OF CONTACT: two armies meet along a front.
branches.cn: 接触之线：两支军队沿一条线相遇。

branches.en: FORWARD FACE: the noun names it, the verb turns it toward something.
branches.cn: 朝前之面：名词命名它，动词把它转向某物。

branches.en: WHAT IS SHOWN: a manner or a business can be a false surface.
branches.cn: 被展示者：举止或商号都可能是虚假的表面。

branches.en: LINES OF EFFORT: one battle line becomes an alliance, then several areas of work.
branches.cn: 努力之线：一条战线变成联盟，再变成多个工作领域。

branches.en: METEOROLOGY: the Bergen school reused the military image for air.
branches.cn: 气象学：卑尔根学派把军事意象重新用于空气。

intro.en: Front is a Latin noun that became an English word family through French; its suffixes are Latin-derived but its compounds are English.
intro.cn: front 是经法语进入英语的拉丁名词，其词族后缀源自拉丁，而复合词为英语构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin frons, frontis is the source; frontal and frontage add Latin-derived suffixes to it.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 frons, frontis 是来源；frontal 与 frontage 在其上添加拉丁来源后缀。

items.meaningCN: 额头；朝前的一面；接触线
items.example: The front of the building was rebuilt.
items.exampleCN: 建筑的正面被重建了。

items.example: Frontal cloud rose along the slope.
items.exampleCN: 锋面云沿斜面升起。

items.example: The shop has a narrow frontage.
items.exampleCN: 这家店临街面很窄。

items.example: The frontier moved west.
items.exampleCN: 边境向西移动。

items.example: Frontline units lacked fuel.
items.exampleCN: 一线部队缺油。

items.example: The seats face frontward.
items.exampleCN: 座位朝向前方。

items.meaning: a front led by cold air
items.meaningCN: 由冷空气主导推进的锋
items.example: The cold front crossed at dawn.
items.exampleCN: 冷锋在黎明时过境。

items.meaning: a front led by warm air
items.meaningCN: 由暖空气主导推进的锋
items.example: The warm front brought drizzle.
items.exampleCN: 暖锋带来了细雨。

items.example: She became the front-runner overnight.
items.exampleCN: 她一夜之间成了领跑者。

definition_zh: 水果；果实；成果；产物
definition_en: the sweet or sour edible product of a plant, or the good result of effort
core_image: 枝头挂着熟透的果子，一摘就落进手心
scene: 果园里的苹果在秋阳下泛红。The farmer let each visitor pick one fruit from the trees before closing the gate.
sceneCN: 这里 fruit 是「水果」（第 1 个义项：植物的食用果实）；句意为关园之前，农夫让每位游客从树上摘一个水果。

derivatives.zh: fruit 加 -ful 构成，义为「多产的；富有成效的」
fruitful 加 -ly 构成，义为「富有成效地」
fruit 加 -less 构成，义为「无结果的；徒劳的」

senses.title: Edible plant product
senses.definition: the seed-bearing part of a plant that people and animals eat
senses.definitionCN: 植物带有种子、可供人或动物食用的部分
senses.example: Oranges and pears are my favourite fruit.
senses.exampleCN: 橙子和梨是我最爱吃的水果。
senses.why: The word directly names the ripened, edible part of a plant, so this sense sits at the center of the image.
senses.whyCN: 这个词直接命名植物成熟可食的部分，因此该义项居于画面中心。

senses.title: Result of effort or action
senses.definition: the good result of work, planning, or effort
senses.definitionCN: 工作、计划或努力带来的好结果
senses.example: Their years of training finally bore fruit.
senses.exampleCN: 他们多年的训练终于开花结果。
senses.why: Ripened fruit is the visible end of a long process, so success is described as fruit appearing.
senses.whyCN: 成熟的果实是漫长过程可见的终点，因此把成功描述为「结出果实」。

senses.title: Botanical seed-bearing structure
senses.definition: in botany, any structure formed from a flower's ovary, whether sweet or not
senses.definitionCN: 植物学上由子房发育成的结构，无论是否味甜
senses.example: A tomato is a fruit in the botanical sense.
senses.exampleCN: 在植物学意义上，番茄是一种果实。
senses.why: Science widened the everyday idea to any flower product, keeping the seed-core image.
senses.whyCN: 科学把日常概念扩展为一切花的产物，保留了「种子核心」的画面。

senses.title: Offspring or product of something
senses.definition: a person, thing, or outcome produced by a particular place or situation
senses.definitionCN: 由特定环境或情形产生的人、物或结果
senses.example: He is the fruit of a strict old school system.
senses.exampleCN: 他是那套严苛旧教育体制的产物。
senses.why: A system produces people the way a tree produces fruit, so the origin image transfers.
senses.whyCN: 体制造就人如同树结出果，来源的画面由此迁移。

senses.title: To produce fruit
senses.definition: to bear fruit, or to make a plant bear fruit
senses.definitionCN: 植物结出果实，或使植物结果
senses.example: The young orchard fruited for the first time this autumn.
senses.exampleCN: 这片幼果园今年秋天第一次结果。
senses.why: The noun names the thing, and the verb names the plant's act of producing it.
senses.whyCN: 名词指果实本身，动词则指植物产出果实这一行为。

intro.en: Fruit came into English from Latin through French, tracing back to a root meaning to enjoy.
intro.cn: fruit 经法语由拉丁语进入英语，可追溯到表示「享用」的词根。

items.en: Latin fructus meant enjoyment, produce, and the fruit of a plant, from the verb frui, to enjoy.
items.cn: 拉丁语 fructus 意为「享用、出产、果实」，来自动词 frui（享用）。

items.en: The past participle fructus literally means the thing enjoyed, that is, the yield.
items.cn: 过去分词 fructus 字面即「被享用的东西」，也就是产出。

items.en: Old French fruit carried the same senses into medieval speech.
items.cn: 古法语 fruit 把这些义项带入中世纪语言。

items.en: Middle English borrowed fruit for both crops and bodily offspring at first.
items.cn: 中古英语借入 fruit，起初既指庄稼收获也指后代子孙。

items.en: Modern English narrowed it to plant produce and its figurative results.
items.cn: 现代英语将其收窄为植物果实及其比喻性成果。

note.en: Fruit is often mixed up with vegetable in daily speech and with fruity in spelling.
note.cn: 日常用语中 fruit 常与 vegetable 混淆，拼写上则易与 fruity 相混。

entries.definitionCN: 嬉戏；与 fruit 拼写开头相近但词源无关
富有成效的；fruit 的同根形容词
果汁；与 fruit 相关但指液体本身

entries.definition: an edible plant part such as leaves or roots
entries.definitionCN: 蔬菜；日常分类中与 fruit 相对

entries.definition: the crop gathered in a season
entries.definitionCN: 收成；与 fruit 的产出义相接
产量；产出，与成果义相呼应

normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实词形的 fruit 记忆钩子。

normal.en: The Latin root frui means to enjoy, so fruit is literally the thing enjoyed.
normal.cn: 拉丁词根 frui 意为享用，fruit 就是「被享用的东西」。

normal.en: Bear fruit covers both real fruit and visible success.
normal.cn: bear fruit 既指结出真果实，也指取得看得见的成效。

normal.en: Fruitful and fruitless form a perfect positive-negative pair.
normal.cn: fruitful 与 fruitless 是一正一反的完美词对。

normal.en: High-frequency phrases like fruit salad and fruit juice reinforce the noun.
normal.cn: fruit salad 与 fruit juice 等高频搭配能巩固名词用法。

normal.en: Use singular fruit for fruit as a group, plural fruits for kinds.
normal.cn: 集合概念用单数 fruit，分种类时用复数 fruits。

abstract.en: Picture picking a ripe apple with its scent still on your fingers.
abstract.cn: 想象摘下一只熟苹果，果香还留在指尖。

abstract.en: See effort as an orchard: first blossom, then fruit.
abstract.cn: 把努力想成果园：先开花，后结果。

abstract.en: The Latin frui begins like the idea of a feast you take part in.
abstract.cn: 拉丁 frui 的发音让人联想到参与一场盛宴的享受。

examples.en: We bought fresh fruit at the market.
examples.cn: 我们在市场上买了新鲜水果。

examples.en: Hard work bore fruit at last.
examples.cn: 努力终于结出了成果。

examples.en: The pear tree fruits early every summer.
examples.cn: 这棵梨树每年夏初就结果。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不入它」——好水果不入它的口太难，看到就想吃。

root: 拉丁词根 frui（享用）→ 过去分词 fructus（被享用之物；产出）→ 古法语 fruit → 英语 fruit；核心语义是「可享用的产出」。

sensesIntro.en: The edible fruit is the center; result, botanical, and product senses grow out of the ripening image.
sensesIntro.cn: 可食的水果是中心；成果、植物学与产物义项都从「成熟结果」的画面生长出来。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ripened yield ready to be enjoyed
core.cn: 核心意象：成熟待享的产出

branches.cn: 植物的产出：日常与科学口径

branches.en: the act and result of bearing fruit
the visible end of a process

intro.en: Fruit builds a small but active family with English suffixes.
intro.cn: fruit 用英语后缀构成了一个小而活跃的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin relatives keep the frug/fruct root of enjoyment.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁同源词保留了 frug/fruct（享用）这一词根。

items.example: Latin frui is the source of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语 frui 是整个词族的源头。

items.example: Fructus passed into French as fruit.
items.exampleCN: fructus 经法语演变为 fruit。

items.example: A fruitful talk saved hours of work.
items.exampleCN: 一次富有成效的会谈省下数小时工作。

items.example: The research proved fruitful.
items.exampleCN: 这项研究证明很有成效。

items.example: The search was fruitless.
items.exampleCN: 这场搜寻毫无结果。

items.example: Fruitless efforts discouraged the team.
items.exampleCN: 徒劳的努力令团队泄气。

items.meaningCN: 节俭的；一般认为与 frui 词根有关联
items.example: A frugal meal kept them going.
items.exampleCN: 一顿简单饭菜让他们撑了下去。

items.example: The fruiting branches bent low.
items.exampleCN: 结果累累的枝条压得很低。

items.meaningCN: 葡萄柚；大型柑橘类水果
items.example: She halved a grapefruit for breakfast.
items.exampleCN: 她切了半个葡萄柚当早餐。

definition_zh: 满的；完整的；充分的；吃饱的；最大的
definition_en: containing as much as possible, complete, or reaching the greatest amount or degree
core_image: 一只倒满的杯子，水面贴着杯沿将溢未溢
scene: 茶壶咕嘟作响，热气漫过桌布。She poured until each cup was full, then set the teapot down.
sceneCN: 这里 full 是「满的」（第 1 个义项：装到不能再装）；句意为她把每只杯子倒得满满的才放下茶壶。

pos.zh: 满的；充满的；完整的；充分的
完全地；整整（常与 -ly 连用或直接修饰）

derivatives.zh: full 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「完全地；充分地」
与 full 同源的日耳曼动词，义为「装满；填满」
full + fill 的组合动词，义为「履行；实现」

senses.title: Containing as much as possible
senses.definition: holding or containing as much as it can
senses.definitionCN: 装着或容纳尽可能多的东西
senses.example: The hall was full long before the concert began.
senses.exampleCN: 音乐会还没开始大厅就坐满了。
senses.why: The image is a container at its limit, so this is the base sense of the word.
senses.whyCN: 画面是容器到达极限，这是词的基础义项。

senses.title: Complete, with nothing missing
senses.definition: including everything; not shortened or partial
senses.definitionCN: 包含全部，没有缩减或缺省
senses.example: Please write your full address on the form.
senses.exampleCN: 请在表格上写完整地址。
senses.why: A full container has no empty space; a full account has no missing part, so completeness extends the container image.
senses.whyCN: 满的容器没有空隙，完整的叙述没有缺漏，因此「完整」扩展了容器画面。

senses.title: Greatest amount or degree
senses.definition: as great, high, or much as possible
senses.definitionCN: 达到尽可能大的程度或数量
senses.example: The bus turned at full speed round the corner.
senses.exampleCN: 巴士全速转过街角。
senses.why: Degree is treated like a container filled to the top, so maximum degree reuses the image.
senses.whyCN: 程度被当作装满的容器来想象，于是「最高程度」复用该画面。

senses.title: Having eaten enough
senses.definition: feeling that you have eaten enough food
senses.definitionCN: 吃了足够的食物之后的饱腹感
senses.example: The children said they were too full for dessert.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们说太饱了，吃不下甜点。
senses.why: The stomach is imagined as a small container that can be filled, so fullness of food reuses the base image.
senses.whyCN: 胃被想象成可填满的小容器，因此「吃饱」复用基础画面。

senses.title: Completely busy or occupied
senses.definition: filled with planned activities or work
senses.definitionCN: 被安排的活动或工作占满
senses.example: Her diary is full until the end of the month.
senses.exampleCN: 她的日程本排到了月底。
senses.why: Time slots behave like container space, so a busy schedule is a filled one.
senses.whyCN: 时间段如同容器空间，因此排满的日程就是「满」的日程。

senses.title: Wide, with a rounded shape
senses.definition: made with extra width or a rounded shape, as of clothing
senses.definitionCN: 衣物做得宽大或带圆弧形状
senses.example: The dancer wore a full skirt that swirled.
senses.exampleCN: 舞者穿着会旋转飞舞的宽摆裙。
senses.why: A garment filled out with fabric looks round and ample, borrowing the filled image for shape.
senses.whyCN: 被布料撑起来的衣物显得圆润丰盈，借「充满」的画面描述形状。

intro.en: Full is a native Germanic adjective whose root also gave fill and many -ful suffixes.
intro.cn: full 是日耳曼本土形容词，其词根同时派生出 fill 与众多 -ful 后缀。

items.en: A Germanic root *ful- meant full, complete.
items.cn: 日耳曼词根 *ful- 表示「满的、完整的」。

items.en: Old English full meant full and complete, already in wide use.
items.cn: 古英语 full 表示「满的、完整的」，已广泛使用。

items.en: The related verb fyllan, to fill, came from the same root family.
items.cn: 同源动词 fyllan（装满）出自同一词根族。

items.en: Middle English full kept both container and completeness senses.
items.cn: 中古英语 full 保留容器义与完整义。

items.en: Modern English full also produced the suffix -ful, meaning full of.
items.cn: 现代英语 full 还产出了后缀 -ful，意为「充满……的」。

note.en: Full is short and common, so it collides with several short look-alikes.
note.cn: full 短小常用，与多个短形近词相撞。

entries.definitionCN: 装满；与 full 同根，是动作动词
傻瓜；与 full 只差一个字母，词源无关
拉；拼写相近但来自不同词根
完整的；与 full 的完整义重叠

entries.definition: completely full of people or things
entries.definitionCN: 挤满的；口语化的满义

entries.definition: whole, with no part left out
entries.definitionCN: 整个的；强调未分割的整体

normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实词形的 full 记忆钩子。

normal.en: Full is the adjective state, fill is the verb action: the state versus the act.
normal.cn: full 是形容词表状态，fill 是动词表动作：状态与动作相对。

normal.en: The suffix -ful grew out of full, so hopeful means full of hope.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ful 由 full 脱落而来，hopeful 即充满希望。

normal.en: The collocation be full of is the most frequent, so learn it first.
normal.cn: 搭配 be full of 最高频，先把它记牢。

normal.en: Feel full covers the everyday scene of finishing a meal.
normal.cn: feel full 覆盖了吃完一顿饭的日常场景。

normal.en: In full means paying or reading everything, nothing held back.
normal.cn: in full 指全额付清或全文读出，毫不保留。

abstract.en: Watch water rise to the brim, one drop short of spilling.
abstract.cn: 看水位涨到杯沿，再一滴就会溢出。

abstract.en: See a diary with every line written in: that schedule is full.
abstract.cn: 想象一页写满的日程本：这就是 full。

abstract.en: Full and fool differ by one o, separating wisdom from silliness.
abstract.cn: full 与 fool 只差一个 o，一个饱满一个痴傻。

examples.en: The bus was full, so we waited for the next one.
examples.cn: 巴士满员了，我们等下一班。

examples.en: Give me your full name, please.
examples.cn: 请告诉我你的全名。

examples.en: I am so full that I cannot eat another bite.
examples.cn: 我太饱了，一口也吃不下。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「福欧」——杯子被倒得满满当当，福气满得快溢出来。

root: 日耳曼本土词根 *ful-（满的、完整）：形容词 full、动词 fill（古英语 fyllan）同根；后缀 -ful 也由 full 脱落而来。

sensesIntro.en: Container fullness is the base; completeness, degree, appetite, schedules, and shape all extend it.
sensesIntro.cn: 容器之满是基础；完整、程度、饱腹、日程与形状义项都是它的延伸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a container filled to its brim
core.cn: 核心意象：装到杯沿的容器

intro.en: Full contributes the most productive native suffix in English, -ful.
intro.cn: full 贡献了英语中最能产的本族后缀 -ful。

latinIntro.en: There are no Latin relatives: full is purely Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词：full 是纯日耳曼词。

items.meaning: full of; having the quality of
items.example: The hopeful children waited by the gate.
items.exampleCN: 满怀希望的孩子们在校门口等候。

items.example: The result made the team hopeful.
items.exampleCN: 结果让团队燃起希望。

items.example: Be careful with the wet paint.
items.exampleCN: 小心，油漆未干。

items.example: Fill the bottle with water.
items.exampleCN: 把瓶子装满水。

items.example: She fulfilled her promise early.
items.exampleCN: 她提前兑现了承诺。

items.example: The bridge is fully open to traffic.
items.exampleCN: 大桥已全面通车。

items.example: Rice porridge is cheap and filling.
items.exampleCN: 米粥便宜又顶饱。

items.example: He answered the question fully.
items.exampleCN: 他完整地回答了问题。

items.meaningCN: 一半；与 full 相对的度量词
items.example: Only half the class came.
items.exampleCN: 班里只有一半人来了。

definition_zh: 乐趣；享乐；有趣的人或事物
definition_en: enjoyment, amusement, or something that provides light-hearted pleasure
core_image: 孩子们在游乐场里大笑奔跑，笑声把空气都点亮了
scene: 游乐场的旋转木马转了起来，铃声和笑声混在一起。The whole class agreed that the trip was great fun from start to finish.
sceneCN: 这里 fun 是「乐趣」（第 1 个义项：轻松愉快的体验）；句意为全班都说这次出行从头到尾都很有趣。

pos.zh: 乐趣；享乐；有趣的人或事
有趣的；令人愉快的（口语）

derivatives.zh: fun 加后缀 -ny 构成，义为「滑稽的；奇怪的」，语义从「有趣」偏移出「古怪」
复合词 fun + fair，义为「游乐场」

senses.title: Enjoyment or amusement
senses.definition: light-hearted pleasure, enjoyment, or good humour
senses.definitionCN: 轻松愉快的体验、消遣或好心情
senses.example: Swimming in the sea is pure fun for children.
senses.exampleCN: 在海里游泳对孩子们来说纯粹是乐趣。
senses.why: The word directly names the feeling of enjoyment, so this sense is the root of all others.
senses.whyCN: 这个词直接命名「愉悦」这种感受，因此它是其余义项的根。

senses.title: A source of amusement
senses.definition: a person, activity, or thing that causes enjoyment
senses.definitionCN: 带来快乐的人、活动或事物
senses.example: Our new teacher is real fun in every lesson.
senses.exampleCN: 我们的新老师每堂课都特别有趣。
senses.why: What gives joy is labelled by the feeling itself, so the cause borrows the name of the effect.
senses.whyCN: 带来快乐的东西被用它产生的感受来称呼，于是「因」借用了「果」的名字。

senses.title: Playful, joking behaviour
senses.definition: playful joking, often teased at someone's expense
senses.definitionCN: 打趣、嬉闹的言行，常带调侃意味
senses.example: She said it all in fun, so nobody was hurt.
senses.exampleCN: 她完全是开玩笑说的，所以没人介意。
senses.why: Joking is enjoyment turned outward toward others, a playful branch of the amusement feeling.
senses.whyCN: 玩笑是把快乐转向他人的方式，是愉悦感的一个嬉闹分支。

senses.title: Amusing as an adjective
senses.titleCN: 有趣的；令人愉快的（形容词用法）
senses.definition: enjoyable and amusing, used informally before a noun
senses.definitionCN: 口语中放在名词前，表示令人愉快的
senses.example: They booked a fun weekend by the lake.
senses.exampleCN: 他们预订了一个湖边的欢乐周末。
senses.why: English often turns popular nouns into adjectives, so fun slid into the describing slot.
senses.whyCN: 英语常把流行名词转作形容词，fun 由此滑入修饰语的位置。

senses.title: Light-hearted style or mood
senses.definition: an atmosphere of playful enjoyment at an event or place
senses.definitionCN: 活动或场所里充满嬉戏愉悦的气氛
senses.example: The fairground carried an air of fun all afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 游乐场整个下午都洋溢着欢乐气氛。
senses.why: A place full of laughing people is sensed as a mood, so the feeling spreads over the setting.
senses.whyCN: 满是笑声的场所会被感受为一种氛围，于是感受弥散到整个场景。

intro.en: Fun is a short native word whose oldest recorded sense was trickery, not joy.
intro.cn: fun 是个简短的本土词，最早的书面含义是「欺骗」而非「快乐」。

items.en: Middle English fon and fonne meant a fool and to fool or trick someone.
items.cn: 中古英语 fon 与 fonne 指傻子，或动词「愚弄、欺骗」。

items.en: It is generally linked to Old French fon, fool, itself of uncertain deeper origin.
items.cn: 一般认为它与古法语 fon（傻子）相关，更早来源不确定。

items.en: By the seventeenth century the meaning shifted from trickery to playful amusement.
items.cn: 到十七世纪，词义从「捉弄」转为「嬉戏娱乐」。

items.en: The verb to fun and the adjective fun appeared as the noun spread.
items.cn: 名词流行后，动词 to fun 与形容词 fun 也出现了。

items.en: Modern English treats fun as noun, adjective, and the base of funny.
items.cn: 现代英语把 fun 用作名词、形容词，也是 funny 的基础。

note.en: Fun, funny, and fun sit close together and are easy to slip between.
note.cn: fun 与 funny、funny 的「古怪」义距离很近，容易混淆。

entries.definitionCN: 滑稽的；（亦指）奇怪的；fun 的形容词派生，注意多义

entries.definition: an admirer, or a device for moving air
entries.definitionCN: 粉丝；风扇；拼写只差一个字母，词源无关
双关语；拼写相近且同属玩笑话题，但词源不同
欢乐；情绪强度高于 fun
娱乐；消遣，较正式的说法
享受；强调主观的愉悦体验

normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实用法的 fun 记忆钩子。

normal.en: Make fun of means teasing, the old trickery sense still living inside.
normal.cn: make fun of 意为取笑，古老的「捉弄」义仍活在短语里。

normal.en: Funny adds -ny to fun but also gains a strange sense.
normal.cn: funny 由 fun 加 -ny 构成，但多出一个「古怪」义。

normal.en: For fun means just for play, no serious purpose.
normal.cn: for fun 表示纯粹闹着玩，没有严肃目的。

normal.en: Have fun is the farewell of every happy outing.
normal.cn: have fun 是每次愉快出游的告别语。

normal.en: A funfair is a fair full of fun, a compound you can hear.
normal.cn: funfair 就是充满 fun 的 fair，复合词读音自带提示。

abstract.en: Picture children running in circles, laughing for no reason at all.
abstract.cn: 想象孩子们绕圈奔跑，毫无缘由地大笑。

abstract.en: Hear the short bright sound of fun, like a quick laugh.
abstract.cn: fun 的发音短促明亮，像一声轻快的笑。

abstract.en: Fun once meant a trick; imagine a joke that turned into joy.
abstract.cn: fun 曾指捉弄，想象一个玩笑最终变成了快乐。

examples.en: We had a lot of fun at the beach.
examples.cn: 我们在海滩玩得很开心。

examples.en: Stop making fun of his haircut.
examples.cn: 别再取笑他的发型了。

examples.en: The quiz was fun and the whole class joined in.
examples.cn: 这次小测验很有趣，全班都参与了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「放」——把烦恼放开，就只剩下乐趣。

root: 一般认为来自中古英语 fon（愚弄、傻子），可能与古法语 fon（傻子）有关，更早来源不确定；词义从「捉弄」演变为「嬉乐」。

sensesIntro.en: The feeling of enjoyment is the root; sources of joy, jokes, adjective use, and atmosphere all branch from it.
sensesIntro.cn: 愉悦感受是根本；快乐的来源、玩笑、形容词用法与气氛都由此分支。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: laughter that lights up a moment
core.cn: 核心意象：点亮时刻的笑声

branches.en: the feeling and the mood it spreads
branches.cn: 感受及其弥散成的氛围

branches.en: people and things that cause joy

intro.en: Fun builds a compact family with suffixes and compounds.
intro.cn: fun 用后缀与复合词构成一个小而紧凑的词族。

latinIntro.en: There are no Latin relatives: fun is a Germanic and French-tinged native word.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词：fun 是日耳曼本土词，仅与法语沾边。

items.example: A funny thing happened on the way.
items.exampleCN: 路上发生了一件怪事。

items.example: The clown told funny stories.
items.exampleCN: 小丑讲了滑稽的故事。

items.example: The funfair opened at noon.
items.exampleCN: 游乐场中午开放。

items.meaning: the spot near the elbow that tingles when struck
items.meaningCN: 肘部麻筋；碰了会发麻的部位
items.example: He knocked his funny bone on the desk.
items.exampleCN: 他的肘部麻筋撞到了桌子。

items.example: A fun-loving crowd filled the park.
items.exampleCN: 一群爱玩乐的人挤满了公园。

items.example: They made fun of his accent.
items.exampleCN: 他们取笑他的口音。

items.example: She paints for fun, not for money.
items.exampleCN: 她画画只为乐趣，不为钱。

items.example: A sunnier, funnier script won the prize.
items.exampleCN: 更阳光更滑稽的剧本获奖了。

items.example: He is a big fan of the band.
items.exampleCN: 他是乐队的铁杆粉丝。

definition_zh: 滑稽的；可笑的；奇怪的；不舒服的
definition_en: amusing and making people laugh, or strange and hard to explain
core_image: 一个人讲笑话讲到一半自己先笑弯了腰
scene: 生日会上，叔叔戴着把假胡子反戴了。Everyone started laughing before he finished the funny story about his first job.
sceneCN: 这里 funny 是「滑稽的」（第 1 个义项：引人发笑）；句意为大家在他讲完关于第一份工作的滑稽故事之前就笑了起来。

pos.zh: 滑稽的；可笑的；奇怪的；微恙的
滑稽人物；笑话（口语，常作 the funny）

collocations.zh: 感到不舒服；觉得怪怪的

derivatives.zh: funny 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「滑稽地；古怪地」
funny 加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「滑稽；古怪」

senses.title: Making people laugh
senses.definition: causing laughter; amusing
senses.definitionCN: 引人发笑的、逗乐的
senses.example: The comedian told a funny joke about queues.
senses.exampleCN: 喜剧演员讲了个关于排队的笑话，十分滑稽。
senses.why: Funny is the adjective of fun, so the laugh-provoking quality is its home sense.
senses.whyCN: funny 是 fun 的形容词，因此「引人发笑」的性质是它的本位义项。

senses.title: Strange or odd
senses.definition: unusual, strange, or hard to explain
senses.definitionCN: 不寻常、古怪或难以解释的
senses.example: There is a funny smell coming from the kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 厨房里飘来一股怪味。
senses.why: A joke and an oddity both break expectations, so the word stretched from amusing to simply strange.
senses.whyCN: 笑话与怪事都打破预期，于是词义从「逗乐」扩张到「怪异」。

senses.title: Slightly unwell
senses.definition: feeling slightly ill or strange in body
senses.definitionCN: 身体略感不适或异样
senses.example: She felt funny after the seafood lunch.
senses.exampleCN: 海鲜午餐后她觉得有点不舒服。
senses.why: The body behaves oddly, and the odd-branch of the word covers it.
senses.whyCN: 身体出现异样，正落在「古怪」这一分支的覆盖范围内。

senses.title: Suspicious or dishonest
senses.definition: not honest or acting suspiciously, as in funny business
senses.definitionCN: 不诚实或行为可疑，如 funny business
senses.example: The manager suspected funny business in the accounts.
senses.exampleCN: 经理怀疑账目里有人搞鬼。
senses.why: Strange behaviour shades into suspicion, extending the odd sense to morality.
senses.whyCN: 古怪的行为向可疑延伸，把「怪异」义推向了道德层面。

senses.title: Hard to explain strictly
senses.definition: deviating slightly from a rule or norm, as a funny angle
senses.definitionCN: 略微偏离常规或规则，如 funny angle
senses.example: The photo caught the tower at a funny angle.
senses.exampleCN: 照片把塔拍出了一个古怪的角度。
senses.why: What strays from the norm is labelled odd, the same stretch as the strange sense.
senses.whyCN: 偏离常态的东西被贴上「怪」的标签，与「奇怪」义项同一条扩张路径。

intro.en: Funny grew directly from fun, adding the adjective suffix -y in the eighteenth century.
intro.cn: funny 直接由 fun 生长而来，十八世纪加上了形容词后缀 -y。

items.en: The base fun still meant fool or trickery when funny was forming.
items.cn: funny 成形时，词基 fun 还带着「愚弄」的意思。

items.en: Funny first appeared around the early eighteenth century meaning odd or tricky.
items.cn: funny 大约在十八世纪初出现，起初意为古怪或狡猾。

items.en: By the nineteenth century the amusing sense had taken over everyday speech.
items.cn: 到十九世纪，「滑稽」义主宰了日常口语。

items.en: The strange sense stayed alive beside the amusing one, especially in feel funny.
items.cn: 「奇怪」义与「滑稽」义并存，尤其在 feel funny 中。

items.en: Modern English keeps both senses, and context decides which one you hear.
items.cn: 现代英语保留两义，靠语境决定听到的是哪一义。

note.en: Funny has two faces: laughter and oddness, each with its own neighbours.
note.cn: funny 有两张面孔：可笑与古怪，各自有不同的近邻。

entries.definitionCN: 乐趣；funny 的名词词基
晴朗的；与 funny 韵尾相同的天气词
小圆面包；拼写相近但词源无关
逗乐的；较正式的说法
极其好笑的；强度远超 funny
奇怪的；覆盖 funny 的古怪义

normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实用法的 funny 记忆钩子。

normal.en: Funny is fun plus -y, the quality of being fun.
normal.cn: funny 就是 fun 加 -y，表示「有乐趣的」这一性质。

normal.en: Feel funny means feeling off, the strange sense in action.
normal.cn: feel funny 表示感觉不对劲，「古怪」义就在其中。

normal.en: Funny business warns of tricks, the old foolery echo.
normal.cn: funny business 提防把戏，呼应古老的「愚弄」义。

normal.en: A funny story always ends in laughter.
normal.cn: funny story 的结局永远是笑声。

normal.en: Funnier and funniest follow the double-n pattern.
normal.cn: funnier 与 funniest 遵循双 n 的变化模式。

abstract.en: Picture a friend mid-joke, laughing before the punchline.
abstract.cn: 想象朋友讲到笑点之前自己先笑了。

abstract.en: Two faces on one coin: a laugh and a raised eyebrow.
abstract.cn: 一枚硬币两面：一面是笑，一面是皱眉。

abstract.en: The odd smell in the kitchen is funny doing its other job.
abstract.cn: 厨房的怪味正是 funny 的另一副面孔在工作。

examples.en: That is the funniest film I have seen this year.
examples.cn: 那是我今年看过最滑稽的电影。

examples.en: The milk tastes funny, do not drink it.
examples.cn: 牛奶味道不对，别喝了。

examples.en: He felt funny in the crowded lift.
examples.cn: 在拥挤的电梯里他觉得不太舒服。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「法你」——滑稽的人总有法子逗你发笑。

root: fun（乐趣，源自中古英语 fon 愚弄）+ 形容词后缀 -y；核心语义经历「古怪 → 滑稽」的双向扩张，两义并存至今。

sensesIntro.en: Laughter is the first face and oddness the second; illness, suspicion, and odd angles hang on the second.
sensesIntro.cn: 发笑是第一面孔，古怪是第二面孔；不适、可疑与怪角度都挂在第二面孔上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: laughter on one side, a raised eyebrow on the other
core.cn: 核心意象：一面是笑声，一面是怀疑的挑眉

branches.en: the double face of the word

intro.en: Funny keeps a small family, mostly built with ordinary suffixes.
intro.cn: funny 的词族不大，主要靠普通后缀构成。

latinIntro.en: There are no Latin relatives: funny is a native formation on fun.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词：funny 是在 fun 上形成的本土构词。

items.example: The party was pure fun.
items.exampleCN: 这场派对纯粹是玩乐。

items.example: A misty morning turned funny-looking.
items.exampleCN: 雾蒙蒙的早晨显得怪模怪样。

items.example: Her second act was funnier.
items.exampleCN: 她的第二段表演更滑稽。

items.example: He won the funniest costume prize.
items.exampleCN: 他赢得最滑稽服装奖。

items.meaning: in an amusing or odd way
items.example: Funnily enough, they met again in Rome.
items.exampleCN: 说来也怪，他们又在罗马重逢了。

items.example: The funniness of the scene hid its sadness.
items.exampleCN: 场面的滑稽掩盖了它的悲伤。

items.example: I feel funny about lending him money.
items.exampleCN: 借钱给他这事让我感觉不妥。

items.example: No funny business at this firm.
items.exampleCN: 本公司绝不容许鬼把戏。

items.example: A strange light filled the sky.
items.exampleCN: 奇异的光照亮了天空。

definition_zh: 家具；（总称）设备；内在装备
definition_en: movable objects such as chairs, tables, and beds that make a room usable
core_image: 搬进新居时一屋子等待摆位的桌椅床柜
scene: 搬家卡车停在楼下，木箱贴着「易碎」标签。The new flat looked empty until the furniture arrived in the afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里 furniture 是「家具」（第 1 个义项：房间内可移动的用具）；句意为下午家具运到之前，新公寓看起来空荡荡的。

collocations.zh: 头脑中的知识储备（比喻）

forms.label: 无词形变化（不可数名词）

derivatives.zh: furniture 的同源动词，义为「布置家具；供应」
furnish 加名词后缀 -er 构成，义为「供应者；家具商」

senses.title: Movable room equipment
senses.definition: movable articles such as tables, chairs, and beds that equip a room
senses.definitionCN: 桌椅床柜等可移动的房间装备
senses.example: They sold their old furniture before moving abroad.
senses.exampleCN: 移居国外前他们卖掉了旧家具。
senses.why: The word names the whole set of movable equipment, so the room-image sits at the center.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名整套可移动装备，因此「房间」的画面居于中心。

senses.title: Equipment of an organization
senses.definition: the useful parts or fittings of an organization, vehicle, or system
senses.definitionCN: 机构、车辆或系统中的实用部件或配置
senses.example: Good research needs the furniture of grants, labs, and journals.
senses.exampleCN: 好的研究离不开经费、实验室与期刊这些配套设施。
senses.why: A room needs furniture to work; an organization likewise needs its fittings, so the image extends.
senses.whyCN: 房间需要家具才能使用，机构同样需要配套，画面由此延伸。

senses.title: Mental equipment
senses.definition: the stock of ideas or knowledge a mind contains
senses.definitionCN: 头脑中储存的思想或知识
senses.example: Logic is part of the furniture of a trained mind.
senses.exampleCN: 逻辑是受过训练的头脑的一部分储备。
senses.why: The mind is pictured as a room furnished with ideas, a borrowed interior.
senses.whyCN: 头脑被想象为用思想陈设的房间，是一种借用的内部空间画面。

senses.title: Wood-worked movable goods
senses.definition: furniture viewed especially as worked wood or joinery
senses.definitionCN: 特指以木作工艺制成的器物
senses.example: This village is known for hand-carved furniture.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村子以手工雕刻木器闻名。
senses.why: Historically most furniture was wood, so a craft sense remains attached.
senses.whyCN: 历史上家具多为木制，因此保留着一个手工艺义项。

senses.title: Fixed fittings by extension
senses.definition: built-in fittings that cannot be moved, used loosely alongside furniture
senses.definitionCN: 与家具并称的不可移动的内装设施
senses.example: The rent includes curtains, lights, and fitted furniture.
senses.exampleCN: 房租包含窗帘、灯具与固定家具。
senses.why: Lists of room contents blur the movable and fixed, so the edge of the sense widens in trade speech.
senses.whyCN: 房屋清单中可动与固定常混列，商业用语放宽了义项边界。

intro.en: Furniture came from French, built on a verb meaning to supply or fit out.
intro.cn: furniture 来自法语，建立在意为「供应、装备」的动词之上。

items.en: Old French furnir meant to supply, complete, or fit out.
items.cn: 古法语 furnir 意为供应、备齐、装备。

items.en: French furnir is of Germanic origin, generally traced to a Frankish root.
items.cn: 法语 furnir 源自日耳曼语，一般认为可追溯到法兰克语词根。

items.en: Middle English borrowed furniture in the sixteenth century for the act of furnishing.
items.cn: 中古英语在十六世纪借入 furniture，指「装备行为」。

items.en: The sense narrowed from equipment in general to movable household goods.
items.cn: 词义从泛指装备收窄为可移动的家居用品。

items.en: The related verb furnish kept the wider supplying sense.
items.cn: 同源动词 furnish 保留了更宽的「供应」义。

note.en: Furniture is uncountable, and learners often meet its near neighbours in house language.
note.cn: furniture 不可数，学习者常在家居语言中遇到它的近邻。

entries.definition: to supply a room with furniture
entries.definitionCN: 布置家具；furniture 的同源动词
炉子；拼写开头相近但词源无关
未来；拼写局部相近，词源不同
家用电器；带电源的设备，与家具分工

entries.definition: a fixed part of a building
entries.definitionCN: 固定装置；与可动家具相对

entries.definition: tools or items needed for a purpose
entries.definitionCN: 装备；泛指一切器材

normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实词形的 furniture 记忆钩子。

normal.en: Furniture is uncountable: say a piece of furniture, never furnitures.
normal.cn: furniture 不可数：说 a piece of furniture，不能加 s。

normal.en: The verb furnish is inside the word: to furnish is to fill with furniture.
normal.cn: 词里藏着动词 furnish：furnish 就是用家具布置。

normal.en: Furni- begins like furnace, but furniture lives in rooms, furnaces in basements.
normal.cn: 词头像 furnace，但 furniture 在房间，furnace 在地下室。

normal.en: The -ture ending marks the French borrow, like picture and nature.
normal.cn: -ture 词尾标记法语借词，同 picture、nature。

normal.en: Furniture of the mind is a set metaphor worth remembering.
normal.cn: the furniture of one's mind 是值得记住的固定比喻。

abstract.en: Picture a bare room filling with table, chairs, and bed one by one.
abstract.cn: 想象空房间里桌椅床一件件落位。

abstract.en: Hear the soft -ture ending, like a drawer sliding closed.
abstract.cn: -ture 的发音像抽屉轻轻关上。

abstract.en: See the mind as a room where ideas are the chairs and lamps.
abstract.cn: 把头脑想成房间，思想是其中的椅子与灯。

examples.en: We bought a piece of furniture for the hallway.
examples.cn: 我们为门厅买了一件家具。

examples.en: Moving house means boxing up all the furniture.
examples.cn: 搬家意味着把所有家具装箱。

examples.en: The study is part of the furniture of his mind.
examples.cn: 这门学问是他头脑储备的一部分。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「弗尼彻」——家具还没彻齐，先请弗尼彻先生来布置。

root: 古法语 furnir（供应、装备，源于日耳曼语）→ 法语 furniture（装备物）→ 英语 furniture；核心语义是「供房间使用的一切装备」。

sensesIntro.en: Household movables are the center; organizational fittings, mental stock, and craft senses extend outward.
sensesIntro.cn: 家居可动用品是中心；机构配置、头脑储备与木作工艺义项向外延伸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a room made usable by its movable gear
core.cn: 核心意象：靠可动装备变得可用的房间

branches.en: contents of a room, movable or fitted
branches.cn: 房间内容物：可动与固定
为居住空间而制的器物

intro.en: The furn- root carries the supplying idea through the family.
intro.cn: 词根 furn- 把「供应」之意贯穿整个词族。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic in origin, so Latin relatives are absent.
latinIntro.cn: 词根源于日耳曼语，因此没有拉丁同源词。

items.example: They furnished the office cheaply.
items.exampleCN: 他们低成本布置了办公室。

items.example: The furnisher delivered all desks on time.
items.exampleCN: 家具商按时送来了所有桌子。

items.meaning: the result or means of an action
items.example: Furniture, picture, and nature share the ending.
items.exampleCN: furniture、picture、nature 共享此词尾。

items.example: The furniture in this cafe is handmade.
items.exampleCN: 这家咖啡馆的家具是手工的。

items.example: The -ure ending often marks borrowed nouns.
items.exampleCN: -ure 词尾常见于借入名词。

items.example: The shop sells curtains and furnishings.
items.exampleCN: 这家店出售窗帘和陈设用品。

items.meaning: the soft fittings of a room
items.example: Bright furnishings warmed the room.
items.exampleCN: 明亮的软装让房间生暖。

items.example: They refurnished the lounge last year.
items.exampleCN: 他们去年重新布置了休息室。

items.example: The re- prefix signals repetition.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 表示重复。

definition_zh: 未来；将来；前途；（语法）将来时；期货
definition_en: the time that will come after now, or what will happen or be possible later
core_image: 一条从脚下伸向雾中的长路，路灯一盏盏亮向远方
scene: 毕业典礼结束，学生们把学士帽抛向天空。Every graduate faced the future with both excitement and a little fear.
sceneCN: 这里 future 是「未来」（第 1 个义项：此刻之后的时间）；句意为每位毕业生都怀着兴奋与些许不安面对未来。

derivatives.zh: future 加名词后缀 -ity 构成，义为「未来性；将来之事」
future 加 -ism 构成，义为「未来主义」

senses.title: The time to come
senses.definition: the period of time that will come after the present
senses.definitionCN: 现在之后将要到来的时间段
senses.example: No one can predict the future with certainty.
senses.exampleCN: 没有人能准确预测未来。
senses.why: The word names the whole of time ahead of us, the base direction sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名我们前方的时间整体，是基础的方向性义项。

senses.title: Prospects or likely success
senses.definition: the chances or prospects awaiting a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 某人或某物等待其去把握的机会或前景
senses.example: She has a bright future in medicine.
senses.exampleCN: 她在医学领域前途光明。
senses.why: The road ahead is read as the fate ahead, so personal prospects borrow the time image.
senses.whyCN: 前方的路被解读为前方的命运，个人前途借用了时间画面。

senses.title: Grammar form for later time
senses.definition: the verb form used to talk about actions after now
senses.definitionCN: 用于谈论现在之后动作的动词形式
senses.example: English marks the future with will or shall.
senses.exampleCN: 英语用 will 或 shall 标记将来。
senses.why: Language packages time into forms, so the time-ahead sense becomes a grammar label.
senses.whyCN: 语言把时间打包成形式，于是「将来」义成为语法标签。

senses.title: Contracts bought for later delivery
senses.definition: agreements to buy or sell goods at set prices on a later date
senses.definitionCN: 约定在日后按定价交割货物的合约
senses.example: Traders bought coffee futures to hedge prices.
senses.exampleCN: 交易商买入咖啡期货对冲价格。
senses.why: Dealing in tomorrow's goods keeps the ahead-of-time idea inside finance.
senses.whyCN: 交易明天的货物，把「 ahead of time」的观念留在金融领域。

senses.title: Coming after the present
senses.definition: happening or existing after now, used before a noun
senses.definitionCN: 发生在现在之后，用于名词前
senses.example: Future meetings will be shorter.
senses.exampleCN: 以后的会议会开得更短。
senses.why: The noun slides into the adjective slot to mark anything belonging to later time.
senses.whyCN: 名词滑入形容词位置，标记一切属于将来的事物。

senses.title: Later holders of a role
senses.definition: someone who will hold a position or status later
senses.definitionCN: 日后将担任某职位或拥有某身份的人
senses.example: the future king greeted the crowd
senses.exampleCN: 未来的国王向人群致意
senses.why: A person's later status is described with the time word fixed before the title.
senses.whyCN: 把时间词固定放在头衔前，即可描述一个人日后的身份。

intro.en: Future descends from Latin futurus, the participle of a verb meaning to be about to be.
intro.cn: future 源自拉丁语 futurus，即意为「将要存在」的动词的分词。

items.en: Latin esse meant to be, and its future participle futurus meant about to be.
items.cn: 拉丁语 esse 意为「存在」，其将来分词 futurus 意为「将要存在的」。

items.en: The stem fu- is an irregular suppletive form of the verb to be.
items.cn: 词干 fu- 是动词 be 的不规则异干替代形式。

items.en: Futurus came to act as a noun, futura, for things to come.
items.cn: futurus 后来名词化为 futura，指将要来临之事。

items.en: Middle English took future from Old French in the fourteenth century.
items.cn: 中古英语十四世纪经古法语借入 future。

items.en: Modern English spread it into grammar, finance, and everyday hope-talk.
items.cn: 现代英语把它扩展进语法、金融与日常的展望用语。

note.en: Future shares a spelling corner with furniture and stands against past in every chart.
note.cn: future 与 furniture 在拼写上相邻，并在各种图表中与 past 相对。

entries.definitionCN: 家具；拼写前部与 future 相近但词源无关
特征；拼写近似，词源不同
未来性；future 的抽象派生词
明天；最近的 future
前景；与前途义重叠
过去；future 的反义词

normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实词形的 future 记忆钩子。

normal.en: Latin futurus literally means about to be, the future is what is about to be.
normal.cn: 拉丁 futurus 字面是「将要存在」，future 就是即将成为的东西。

normal.en: In the future is the phrase that opens every prediction.
normal.cn: in the future 是开启一切预测的短语。

normal.en: Future tense uses will, the lightest verb in English.
normal.cn: 将来时用 will，是英语里最轻的动词。

normal.en: Futures in finance are deals about tomorrow's goods.
normal.cn: 金融里的 futures 是关于明天货物的合约。

normal.en: The fu- stem belongs to the verb to be itself.
normal.cn: 词干 fu- 属于动词 be 的不规则变化。

abstract.en: Picture a road vanishing into morning mist, lamps lighting one by one.
abstract.cn: 想象一条路没入晨雾，路灯一盏盏亮起。

abstract.en: Hear fu- like the start of fuel: the future feeds what is coming.
abstract.cn: fu- 的发音像 fuel 的开头：未来在为将至之事供能。

abstract.en: Throw a cap in the air, and it hangs between now and later.
abstract.cn: 把帽子抛上天，它悬在现在与未来之间。

examples.en: In the future, cars may drive themselves.
examples.cn: 未来汽车也许能自动驾驶。

examples.en: She has a bright future ahead of her.
examples.cn: 她前途一片光明。

examples.en: Keep this letter for future reference.
examples.cn: 把这封信留着以后参考。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「费用车」——通往未来的路上，先备好费用和车。

root: 拉丁 esse（存在）的将来分词 futurus（将要存在的）→ 经古法语进入英语 future；词干 fu- 是动词 be 的异干形式。

sensesIntro.en: Time ahead is the trunk; prospects, grammar, finance, and adjective uses branch off it.
sensesIntro.cn: 前方的时间是主干；前途、语法、金融与形容词用法都从它分出。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the road ahead of now, lit toward the horizon
core.cn: 核心意象：此刻之前的路，灯光指向地平线

branches.cn: 后来的时间：名词与形容词

branches.en: before-noun marking of later things and roles
branches.cn: 名词前标记未来事物与身份

intro.en: Future keeps a compact international family around the Latin fu- stem.
intro.cn: future 围绕拉丁词干 fu- 构成紧凑的国际化词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin relatives keep the to-be stem alive across languages.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁同源词让「存在」词干在各语言中延续。

items.example: Futurus is the direct parent of future.
items.exampleCN: futurus 是 future 的直接来源。

items.example: Esse is the underlying verb of the fu- stem.
items.exampleCN: esse 是 fu- 词底的动词。

items.meaning: the state of being to come
items.example: Philosophers debate the futurity of the past.
items.exampleCN: 哲学家争论过去的未来性。

items.example: The -ity suffix builds abstract nouns.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ity 构成抽象名词。

items.meaning: an early art movement of speed and machines
items.example: Futurism glorified engines and speed.
items.exampleCN: 未来主义颂扬引擎与速度。

items.example: The -ism ending marks schools of thought.
items.exampleCN: -ism 词尾标记思想流派。

items.example: Will is the marker of the future tense.
items.exampleCN: will 是将来时的标记。

items.example: We save water for future generations.
items.exampleCN: 我们为后代节水。

items.meaning: first in rank (same era of borrowing)
items.meaningCN: 首要的；同期借入的拉丁系词
items.example: The future premier studied law here.
items.exampleCN: 未来的总理在此学过法律。

definition_zh: 画廊；美术馆；楼座；走廊；一批收藏
definition_en: a room or building for showing art, or a raised seating area or long passage
core_image: 长廊两侧挂满画框，参观者缓步从一幅画走到另一幅
scene: 美术馆开门时阳光斜照进长廊。A quiet gallery showed watercolours from thirty young painters this spring.
sceneCN: 这里 gallery 是「画廊；美术馆」（第 1 个义项：陈列艺术品的场所）；句意为今年春天一家安静的美术馆展出了三十位年轻画家的水彩画。

collocations.zh: 迎合大众口味博取喝彩

derivatives.zh: gallery 加 -ist 构成，义为「画廊经营者」
gallery 的意大利语式再借词，义为「拱廊商业街；购物廊」

senses.title: Room for showing art
senses.definition: a room or building where paintings and sculptures are shown
senses.definitionCN: 陈列绘画与雕塑的房间或建筑
senses.example: The city gallery is free on Sundays.
senses.exampleCN: 市立美术馆周日免费开放。
senses.why: The word first meant a long covered passage, and art hung along such walls, so the room sense grew there.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指带顶的长廊，画作就挂在这样的墙上，展示空间的义项由此生长。

senses.title: Raised seating tier
senses.definition: the highest balcony with the cheapest seats in a theatre
senses.definitionCN: 剧院里位置最高、票价最低的楼座
senses.example: Students watched the opera from the gallery.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们从楼座看歌剧。
senses.why: A long passage turns upward in a building; the gallery is literally the upper corridor of seats.
senses.whyCN: 长廊在建筑中向上转折，gallery 字面就是座位构成的高层走廊。

senses.title: Spectators collectively
senses.definition: the people watching, especially in court or a theatre
senses.definitionCN: 观看的人，尤指法庭或剧院中的旁听者
senses.example: The lawyer's joke woke the gallery.
senses.exampleCN: 律师的玩笑逗醒了旁听席。
senses.why: Seats name the seated; the tier label slid onto the people sitting there.
senses.whyCN: 座位可以代指就座者，楼座的称呼滑向了坐在那里的人。

senses.title: Underground passage in a mine
senses.definition: a horizontal tunnel dug in a mine
senses.definitionCN: 矿井中开凿的水平巷道
senses.example: The engineers walked the gallery to check the supports.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师们走过巷道检查支护。
senses.why: Mining kept the original covered-passage idea more literally than art did.
senses.whyCN: 采矿比艺术更直接地保留了「带顶长廊」的本义。

senses.title: Collection shown together
senses.definition: a set of pictures, photos, or items shown as a group
senses.definitionCN: 作为一组展示的图片或物品
senses.example: The website added a photo gallery of the trip.
senses.exampleCN: 网站添加了这次旅行的照片集。
senses.why: A room of paintings became a page of pictures; the grouping idea survived the screen.
senses.whyCN: 一间挂画的房间变成了一页图片，成组陈列的观念在屏幕时代延续。

intro.en: Gallery entered English from French and Italian, ultimately from a word for a great tank or store-room.
intro.cn: gallery 经法语与意大利语进入英语，最终源于意为「大蓄水池、储藏室」的词。

items.en: Italian galleria meant a long portico or passage, borrowed from medieval forms.
items.cn: 意大利语 galleria 指有柱廊的长通道，借自中世纪的形式。

items.en: Medieval Latin galeria is generally linked to galilea, a church porch, of disputed origin.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 galeria 一般认为与 galilea（教堂门廊）相关，来源有争议。

items.en: Old French galerie carried the passage sense into English speech.
items.cn: 古法语 galerie 带着通道义进入英语。

items.en: Middle English gallery at first meant a long covered walk or balcony.
items.cn: 中古英语 gallery 起初指带顶长廊或楼台。

items.en: Art display, theatre tiers, mine tunnels, and photo sets all kept the long-aisle image.
items.cn: 艺术陈列、剧院楼座、矿巷与图片集都保留了「长廊」意象。

note.en: Gallery overlaps with museum and hall, and hides a spelling trap in gallery vs galley.
note.cn: gallery 与 museum、hall 意义交叉，拼写上则要与 galley 区分。

entries.definition: a ship rowed by oars, or a ship's kitchen
entries.definitionCN: 桨帆船；船上的厨房；与 gallery 只差两个字母，词源无关
拱廊商业街；gallery 的意大利语式同源词
橡胶套鞋；拼写开头相近但词源无关

拱廊街；与 gallery 同源的商业分支
楼台；与楼座义相邻

normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实词形的 gallery 记忆钩子。

normal.en: Gallery is a hall with a series of walls, and series appears in its pronunciation.
normal.cn: gallery 是带有一排排墙面的厅，读音里藏着 series 的意味。

normal.en: Play to the gallery means aiming jokes at the cheap seats.
normal.cn: play to the gallery 指迎合最便宜的楼座观众。

normal.en: Mine galleries are the passage sense kept underground.
normal.cn: 矿道 gallery 是「通道」本义留在地下的样子。

normal.en: A photo gallery is a wall of pictures moved onto a page.
normal.cn: photo gallery 是把挂画之墙搬到网页上。

normal.en: Do not confuse gallery with galley, the ship's kitchen.
normal.cn: 不要把 gallery 与船厨 galley 弄混。

abstract.en: Walk a long painted corridor: that walk is the word's skeleton.
abstract.cn: 走一条挂满画的长廊：这段行走就是词的骨架。

abstract.en: Hear the double l like two pillars holding a roof.
abstract.cn: 双写 l 像两根撑着屋顶的柱子。

abstract.en: Climb theatre stairs to the cheap top seats, the gallery's other face.
abstract.cn: 沿剧院台阶爬到顶层廉价座，那是 gallery 的另一张脸。

examples.en: Her paintings hang in a small gallery downtown.
examples.cn: 她的画挂在市中心一家小画廊里。

examples.en: We sat in the gallery and still heard every note.
examples.cn: 我们坐在楼座上，每个音符都听得见。

examples.en: The engineers inspected a flooded mine gallery.
examples.cn: 工程师检查了一条被水淹没的矿巷。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「戛勒瑞」——画廊里挂了勒级的珍贵画卷，瑞气满堂。

root: 一般认为源于中世纪拉丁语 galeria（长廊），或与教会门廊 galilea 相关，来源存疑；核心意象始终是「带顶的长通道」。

sensesIntro.en: The long passage is the skeleton; art halls, theatre tiers, mine tunnels, and photo sets hang along it.
sensesIntro.cn: 长通道是骨架；艺术殿堂、剧院楼座、矿巷与图片集都沿它排开。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long roofed aisle with things placed along it
core.cn: 核心意象：两侧排布展品的长廊

branches.en: tunnels kept from the old sense

intro.en: Gallery spawned one international offspring and many everyday phrases.
intro.cn: gallery 派生出一个国际化的后代词与许多日常短语。

latinIntro.en: Medieval Latin galeria is the recorded stop on the way into English.
latinIntro.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 galeria 是该词进入英语途中被记录的一站。

items.example: Galeria is the earliest written ancestor here.
items.exampleCN: galeria 是这里可考的最早书面祖先。

items.example: Galilea named porches at some Italian churches.
items.exampleCN: galilea 曾指意大利一些教堂的门廊。

items.example: Milan's galleria is roofed in glass.
items.exampleCN: 米兰的拱廊街以玻璃封顶。

items.example: The -aria ending marks places in Italian borrowings.
items.exampleCN: -aria 词尾在意大利语借词中标记场所。

items.meaning: a set of pictures on show
items.example: The site updated its photo gallery.
items.exampleCN: 网站更新了图片廊。

items.example: Some politicians always play to the gallery.
items.exampleCN: 有些政客总是哗众取宠。

items.meaning: seats for visitors in court or parliament
items.example: The public gallery filled by nine.
items.exampleCN: 九点前旁听席就满了。

items.example: The press gallery hummed before the speech.
items.exampleCN: 演讲前记者席一片低语。

items.example: A theft from a gallery made headlines.
items.exampleCN: 画廊失窃案登上了头条。

definition_zh: 游戏；比赛；运动项目；猎物；（口语）勇气
definition_en: an activity with rules for play, a contest, wild animals hunted for food, or willingness to try
core_image: 规则铺开的小棋盘与荒野中可供追猎的走兽
scene: 运动场边坐满了加油的家长。The final game of the season ended in a two-one victory.
sceneCN: 这里 game 是「比赛」（第 2 个义项：有规则的竞技活动）；句意为本赛季最后一场比赛以二比一的胜利结束。

derivatives.zh: game 加 -er 构成，义为「游戏玩家」
game（形容词）加 -ly 构成，义为「勇敢地；兴致勃勃地」

senses.title: An activity with rules for play
senses.definition: an activity done for fun that follows rules, often with others
senses.definitionCN: 按规则进行、常与他人同玩的娱乐活动
senses.example: The children invented a counting game with pebbles.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们用石子发明了一个数数游戏。
senses.why: The word first names structured play, so the rule-bound activity is the base image.
senses.whyCN: 这个词首先命名有结构的玩耍，因此按规则展开的活动是基础画面。

senses.title: A competitive match
senses.definition: a single contest in a sport, decided by points or goals
senses.definitionCN: 体育中以得分或进球决定胜负的一场竞技
senses.example: They lost the first game but won the second.
senses.exampleCN: 他们输了第一局却赢了第二局。
senses.why: Structured play with winners is one step from games to matches, so the contest sense splits off.
senses.whyCN: 有输赢的结构化玩耍离比赛只差一步，竞技义项由此分出。

senses.title: Wild animals hunted for food
senses.definition: wild animals or birds hunted for sport or food
senses.definitionCN: 被追猎以取食或取乐的野兽野禽
senses.example: Hunters packed salted game for the winter.
senses.exampleCN: 猎人腌制野味以过冬。
senses.why: Hunting is play with serious stakes; the contest frame was applied to the quarry itself.
senses.whyCN: 打猎是一场利益重大的「竞技」，竞技框架被套到了猎获对象身上。

senses.title: Willingness to try
senses.definition: ready and eager to try something new or hard
senses.definitionCN: 乐于尝试新事物或难事
senses.example: Are you game for a night walk along the river?
senses.exampleCN: 你愿意来一次夜走河边吗？
senses.why: Entering a game means accepting the challenge, so courage borrows the play frame.
senses.whyCN: 入场即意味着接受挑战，于是「勇气」借用了游戏的框架。

senses.title: A scheme or trick
senses.definition: a secret plan or way of behaving to gain an advantage
senses.definitionCN: 为占便宜而设的暗中打算或行为方式
senses.example: I see what you are doing, and the game is over.
senses.exampleCN: 我知道你在干什么，这套把戏该收场了。
senses.why: Every game has hidden moves, so scheming borrowed the play language.
senses.whyCN: 每场游戏都有暗藏的步骤，于是「谋划」借用了游戏语言。

senses.title: A single round or set
senses.definition: one part of a larger match, as one set in tennis
senses.definitionCN: 大赛中的一小节，如网球的一局
senses.example: She wrapped up the third game in four minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 她用四分钟拿下了第三局。
senses.why: A match is divided like a story into chapters, and each chapter keeps the game name.
senses.whyCN: 大赛像故事一样分章，每一章沿用了 game 的名字。

intro.en: Game comes from an Old English word for joy and sport, cousin to gammon and backgammon.
intro.cn: game 源自古英语中表示欢乐与嬉戏的词，与 gammon、backgammon 是亲戚。

items.en: Old English gamen meant joy, sport, and amusement.
items.cn: 古英语 gamen 意为欢乐、嬉戏、消遣。

items.en: It descends from a Germanic root *ga- with a collective force, joined to a stem of fun.
items.cn: 它出自日耳曼词根 *ga-（带集合意味）加一个表示欢乐的词干。

items.en: Middle English shortened gamen to game and widened it to contests.
items.cn: 中古英语把 gamen 缩为 game，并扩展出比赛义。

items.en: The hunting sense appeared in medieval texts for quarry worth pursuing.
items.cn: 中世纪文本中已出现指值得追猎之物的狩猎义。

items.en: Modern English keeps play, match, quarry, scheme, and the game-adjective.
items.cn: 现代英语保留了玩耍、比赛、猎物、把戏与形容词用法。

note.en: Game sits next to match, play, and gambit, each holding a corner of the field.
note.cn: game 与 match、play、gambit 相邻，各占场地一角。

entries.definition: a person who plays video games
entries.definitionCN: 游戏玩家；game 的派生词

entries.definition: an opening move risking something for gain
entries.definitionCN: 开局让棋；策略性开局，与 game 同属博弈词场
大风；拼写相近但词源无关
比赛；正式赛事常用 match
玩耍；总称，无规则色彩
体育运动；强调体能与技巧

normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实用法的 game 记忆钩子。

normal.en: Old English gamen meant joy, and backgammon still carries the -gamen tail.
normal.cn: 古英语 gamen 意为欢乐，backgammon 仍保留 -gamen 词尾。

normal.en: Be game for something means willing to enter the arena.
normal.cn: be game for something 表示愿意入场一试。

normal.en: Game meat is food you chase before you cook.
normal.cn: game meat 是先追猎后烹煮的食材。

normal.en: The Olympic Games keeps the plural, a festival of many contests.
normal.cn: the Olympic Games 用复数，是诸多赛事的盛会。

normal.en: The game is over is the fixed way to end a trick.
normal.cn: the game is over 是宣告把戏终结的固定说法。

abstract.en: See a chessboard: rules on one side, a hare in the forest on the other.
abstract.cn: 看棋盘：一边是规则，另一边是林间的野兔。

abstract.en: Hear the hard g open the word like a whistle starting play.
abstract.cn: 硬音 g 开头，像哨声宣告开赛。

abstract.en: A raised eyebrow and a grin: the face of someone deciding to be game.
abstract.cn: 挑眉加咧嘴：一个决定一试的人的表情。

examples.en: We played a game of cards after dinner.
examples.cn: 晚饭后我们打了牌。

examples.en: The deer is legally protected game in autumn.
examples.cn: 鹿在秋季是受法律保护的猎物。

examples.en: She was game to try the longest slide.
examples.cn: 她乐于尝试最长的滑梯。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「给母」——游戏赢了，妈妈给奖励。

root: 古英语 gamen（欢乐、嬉戏）→ 中古英语 game；一般认为出自日耳曼语前缀 ga-（集合）加欢乐词干；与 backgammon 同族。

sensesIntro.en: Rule-bound play is the trunk; matches, quarry, courage, schemes, and single rounds branch out.
sensesIntro.cn: 有规则的玩耍是主干；比赛、猎物、胆量、把戏与单局各成分支。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rule-bound play with something at stake
core.cn: 核心意象：有利害牵动的规则化玩耍

intro.en: Game contributes a handy family of compounds and small suffix forms.
intro.cn: game 构成了一个实用的复合词与小后缀词族。

latinIntro.en: There are no Latin relatives: game is fully Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词：game 是纯日耳曼词。

items.example: Gamen is the ancestor of game.
items.exampleCN: gamen 是 game 的祖先。

items.example: They played backgammon by the fire.
items.exampleCN: 他们在炉边玩双陆棋。

items.example: The gamer streams every Friday.
items.exampleCN: 这位玩家每周五直播。

items.example: The -er suffix names agents.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 命名施动者。

items.example: He gamely took the last penalty.
items.exampleCN: 他勇敢地罚了最后一球。

items.meaning: a sport played with a ball
items.example: Baseball is the classic American ball game.
items.exampleCN: 棒球是经典的美式球类运动。

items.example: The new battery is a game changer.
items.exampleCN: 这种新电池将改变全局。

items.example: Veterans know every trick of gamesmanship.
items.exampleCN: 老将深谙赛场心计的每招每式。

items.meaning: skill or conduct in a role
items.meaningCN: 某角色中的技能或做派
items.example: The -manship ending builds conduct nouns.
items.exampleCN: -manship 词尾构成行为名词。

definition_zh: 车库；汽车修理厂；（美）车库 sale 式的旧货市集
definition_en: a building where a car is kept or repaired
core_image: 卷帘门升起，车灯照亮一车库的工具与油味
scene: 傍晚，爸爸掀开防水布检查轮胎。The car hid in the garage from the sudden summer rain.
sceneCN: 这里 garage 是「车库」（第 1 个义项：存放汽车的建筑）；句意为骤雨突至，汽车躲进了车库。

derivatives.zh: 动词 garaged 的分词形容词用法，义为「存放在车库里的」
动名词形式，义为「车辆入库存放」

senses.title: A building for keeping a car
senses.definition: a shelter or building where a car or vehicle is stored
senses.definitionCN: 存放汽车等车辆的建筑或棚屋
senses.example: The ladder lives in the garage next to the bicycle.
senses.exampleCN: 梯子放在车库里的自行车旁边。
senses.why: The word first named the safe shelter of a vehicle, so the storage image is the base.
senses.whyCN: 这个词首先指车辆的安全庇护所，存放画面是基础。

senses.title: A workshop for vehicle repair
senses.definition: a business place where vehicles are repaired or serviced
senses.definitionCN: 修理或保养车辆的营业场所
senses.example: The mechanic at the garage checked the brakes.
senses.exampleCN: 修车厂的技师检查了刹车。
senses.why: A shelter that keeps cars invites keeping them healthy, so repair grew on the same spot.
senses.whyCN: 存放车辆的地方自然延伸为养护车辆，修理义在同一地点生长。

senses.title: Fuel and service station
senses.definition: a roadside place selling petrol and small repairs, chiefly British
senses.definitionCN: 英式英语中路旁售油兼小修的场所
senses.example: They stopped at the garage to fill the tank.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在加油站停车加油。
senses.why: One roof once covered petrol pumps, tyres, and tools, so the name covered the forecourt too.
senses.whyCN: 一个屋顶曾同时罩住油泵、轮胎与工具，于是名称也覆盖了整个场院。

senses.title: To park in a shelter
senses.definition: to put or keep a vehicle in a garage
senses.definitionCN: 把车辆放入车库保管
senses.example: Remember to garage the scooter before the frost.
senses.exampleCN: 霜冻前记得把小摩托收进车库。
senses.why: Buildings act, in English habit, so the place lent itself to a verb.
senses.whyCN: 英语习惯让建筑「行动」，于是场所名转为动词。

senses.title: Humble home-made origin
senses.definition: started in a home garage, describing famous low-budget beginnings
senses.definitionCN: 形容从自家车库起步的知名创业或乐队
senses.example: The company tells a garage start-up story.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司讲述着车库创业的故事。
senses.why: The garage is the least expensive room with a lock, so dreams started there and the label stuck.
senses.whyCN: 车库是最便宜的有锁空间，梦想从那里起步，标签随之定型。

intro.en: Garage is French in origin, built on a word for shelter or protection.
intro.cn: garage 源于法语，建立在表示庇护、防护的词上。

items.en: French garer meant to shelter, to dock, or to protect.
items.cn: 法语 garer 意为庇护、停靠、防护。

items.en: Garer itself is generally traced to a Germanic root meaning to guard or watch.
items.cn: garer 一般认为源自意为看守、警戒的日耳曼词根。

items.en: French garage formed as the place where vehicles were garées.
items.cn: 法语 garage 由「被庇护之所」构成车辆存放地。

items.en: English borrowed garage around the first automobile age, about one century ago.
items.cn: 英语在汽车时代之初，约一个世纪前借入 garage。

items.en: Modern English extended it to repairs, petrol, verbs, and start-up legends.
items.cn: 现代英语把它扩展到维修、加油、动词用法与创业传奇。

note.en: Garage carries two British pronunciations and hides near-neighbours like garbage.
note.cn: garage 在英式英语中读音分裂，拼写上还紧邻 garbage。

entries.definitionCN: 垃圾；与 garage 拼写相近，词源不同
车辆存放；garage 的动名词形式
四轮马车；拼写近似但词源无关

entries.definition: a roofed open shelter for a car
entries.definitionCN: 车棚；开放式的车库替代

entries.definition: a room for making or repairing
entries.definitionCN: 工坊；与修理义交叉
库房；维修站，规模更大

normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实用法的 garage 记忆钩子。

normal.en: French garer means to shelter, and shelter is the word's heart.
normal.cn: 法语 garer 意为庇护，庇护正是这个词的心脏。

normal.en: Garage sale sells what no longer fits in the garage.
normal.cn: garage sale 卖的是车库里放不下的东西。

normal.en: British speech splits between GAR-ahzh and GA-ridge.
normal.cn: 英式读音在 GAR-ahzh 与 GA-ridge 之间分裂。

normal.en: A garage band rehearses where a car should be.
normal.cn: garage band 在本该停车的地方排练。

normal.en: Garbage and garage differ by one middle letter.
normal.cn: garbage 与 garage 只差中间一个字母。

abstract.en: See the roller door rise and headlight beams sweep the tools.
abstract.cn: 看卷帘门升起，车灯扫过一排排工具。

abstract.en: Hear the French tail -age, soft as engine idle.
abstract.cn: 法语词尾 -age 读起来像发动机的怠速声。

abstract.en: Picture two famous companies born where a lawnmower once parked.
abstract.cn: 想象两家著名公司诞生在从前停割草机的地方。

examples.en: He converted the garage into a small workshop.
examples.cn: 他把车库改成了小工坊。

examples.en: The garage replaced the gearbox in one afternoon.
examples.cn: 修车厂一下午就换好了变速箱。

examples.en: Remember to garage the bicycle tonight.
examples.cn: 今晚记得把自行车收进车库。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「盖瑞奇」——盖瑞奇把车盖好放进奇大的车库。

root: 法语 garer（庇护、停靠）+ 名词后缀 -age；一般认为 garer 源自日耳曼语的「看守」词根；核心语义是「庇护之所」。

sensesIntro.en: Vehicle shelter is the base; repair shops, petrol stops, the verb, and start-up lore all grew around it.
sensesIntro.cn: 车辆庇护所是基础；修车厂、加油站、动词用法与创业传说都围绕它生长。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a locked roof built over a vehicle
core.cn: 核心意象：罩在车辆上方的有锁屋顶

intro.en: The gar- shelter root reappears in both English and French neighbours.
intro.cn: gar- 庇护词根在英语与法语近邻词中反复出现。

latinIntro.en: Germanic cousins of garer keep the guarding idea.
latinIntro.cn: garer 的日耳曼同源词保留了「看守」之意。

items.example: Garez la voiture dans la cour, the French still say.
items.exampleCN: 法语至今仍说把车停进院子。

items.example: The -age ending marks many French loans.
items.exampleCN: -age 词尾见于众多法语借词。

items.exampleCN: 保修卡就是你的保证书。

items.exampleCN: 一名卫兵站在门口。

items.example: Indoor garaging costs extra.
items.exampleCN: 室内存放需另付费。

items.example: Saturday brought a garage sale next door.

items.example: The old garrison guarded the pass.

scene: 厨房水槽边堆着摘下的菜叶。Please take the garbage out before the collection truck arrives.
sceneCN: 这里 garbage 是「垃圾」（第 1 个义项：要丢弃的废物）；句意为收运车到达前请把垃圾拿出去。
