derivatives.zh: 复合词 garbage + man，义为「垃圾清运工」（美式）
复合词 garbage + can，义为「垃圾桶」

senses.title: Thrown-away waste
senses.definition: material that is no longer wanted and is thrown away
senses.definitionCN: 不再需要、要被丢掉的东西
senses.example: Rotten vegetables went straight into the garbage.
senses.exampleCN: 烂掉的蔬菜被直接丢进了垃圾里。
senses.why: The word names the unwanted remainder of daily life, the base sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名日常生活中被淘汰的部分，是基础义项。

senses.title: Worthless speech or writing
senses.definition: talk or writing that is silly, wrong, or without value
senses.definitionCN: 愚蠢、错误或毫无价值的言语或文字
senses.example: That report is pure garbage, full of copied lines.
senses.exampleCN: 那份报告纯粹是垃圾，全是抄袭的句子。
senses.why: Waste is judged, then words judged worthless follow the same bin image.
senses.whyCN: 垃圾是被评判的废物，无价值的言语沿用同一只「桶」的画面。

senses.title: Useless data in computing
senses.definition: input or output that a program cannot use sensibly
senses.definitionCN: 程序无法有效处理的输入或输出
senses.example: The crash was caused by garbage in the file.
senses.exampleCN: 崩溃是由文件里的无效数据引起的。
senses.why: Machines mirror kitchens: what no one can use is garbage there too.
senses.whyCN: 机器映照厨房：没人能用得上的东西在那里同样是垃圾。

senses.title: Refuse as a category
senses.definition: refuse collected from homes, seen as one stream
senses.definitionCN: 从家庭收走、被视为一股流的弃置物
senses.example: City garbage rises after every holiday.
senses.exampleCN: 每逢节后城市垃圾都会增多。
senses.why: Many small wastes become one civic problem, and the mass noun holds them together.
senses.whyCN: 无数小废弃物汇成一个市政问题，不可数名词把它们拢在一起。

senses.title: To discard or dismiss
senses.definition: to throw away or reject completely, informal
senses.definitionCN: 口语中指扔掉或彻底否定
senses.example: They garbaged the draft and started over.
senses.exampleCN: 他们废掉了草稿，从头再来。
senses.why: Judging words as waste leads to treating them as waste, so the verb was coined.
senses.whyCN: 把言语判为废物便将其当废物处理，动词由此造出。

intro.en: Garbage began as a word for the waste bits of a butchered animal, and its deeper origin is uncertain.
intro.cn: garbage 起初指宰杀后禽畜的废料，更深的来源不确定。

items.en: The first attested sense was giblets and offal of poultry, with the root unexplained.
items.cn: 最早记录的义项是禽类内脏与下脚料，词根无法确解。

items.en: Middle English garbage named kitchen waste long before street refuse.
items.cn: 中古英语 garbage 在指街道垃圾之前早已指厨余废料。

items.en: An Old French garnete or garbage, mean scraps, is often suggested but not proven.
items.cn: 常被引证的古法语 garnete 或 garbage（意为碎屑）并无确证。

items.en: The sense widened from meat waste to all household refuse.
items.cn: 词义从肉食废料扩展到一切家庭废弃物。

items.en: American English added the computing and verbal uses, garbage in, garbage out.
items.cn: 美式英语加入了计算与动词用法，即 garbage in, garbage out。

note.en: Garbage, rubbish, and trash split by region, and garbage hides next to garage in spelling.
note.cn: garbage、rubbish、trash 按地区分工，拼写上 garbage 又紧邻 garage。

entries.definitionCN: 车库；与 garbage 拼写相近但词源无关
服装；拼写开头相近，词源无关
垃圾桶；garbage 的复合词

entries.definition: British word for refuse and nonsense
entries.definitionCN: 垃圾（英式）；兼指废话
垃圾（美式）；更口语化

entries.definition: material thrown away or used poorly
entries.definitionCN: 废弃物；泛指丢弃或浪费之物

normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实用法的 garbage 记忆钩子。

normal.en: Garbage is uncountable: take out the garbage, never a garbage.
normal.cn: garbage 不可数：说 take out the garbage，不加冠词单数。

normal.en: Garbage in, garbage out is the programmer's oldest warning.
normal.cn: garbage in, garbage out 是程序员最古老的警句。

normal.en: British rubbish and American trash map onto garbage.
normal.cn: 英式 rubbish 与美式 trash 对应 garbage。

normal.en: Garbage can is American, dustbin is British.
normal.cn: 美式说 garbage can，英式说 dustbin。

normal.en: Talk garbage is the direct way to call words worthless.
normal.cn: talk garbage 直接把言语判为废物。

abstract.en: Picture the bin liner straining at its knot.
abstract.cn: 想象垃圾袋被结口绷得鼓鼓的。

abstract.en: Smell the kitchen bin the day before collection.
abstract.cn: 收运前一天的厨房垃圾桶的气味。

abstract.en: A torn manuscript in the bin equals words become garbage.
abstract.cn: 纸篓里撕碎的稿子等于言语沦为垃圾。

examples.en: Do not leave garbage on the beach.
examples.cn: 不要在海滩上留垃圾。

examples.en: Stop watching that garbage on television.
examples.cn: 别再看电视上那些垃圾节目了。

examples.en: The algorithm failed because of garbage input.
examples.cn: 算法因无效输入而失败。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「嘎比奇」——垃圾桶盖没盖严，嘎吱一声比奇的怪味冲出来。

root: 来源不确定：最早记录指禽畜下脚料，中古英语扩展为厨余、街市废弃物；与 garage 拼写相近但词源无关。

sensesIntro.en: Household waste is the root; worthless words, bad data, civic refuse, and the dismissive verb branch out.
sensesIntro.cn: 家庭废弃物是根；废话、坏数据、市政弃置物与否定动词都由此分支。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: what is judged useless and thrown away
core.cn: 核心意象：被判无用而丢弃之物

branches.en: words fit only for the bin

branches.cn: 把想法扔进桶里的行为

intro.en: Garbage mostly stands alone, with compounds doing the family work.
intro.cn: garbage 多独立使用，家族工作主要靠复合词完成。

latinIntro.en: There are no Latin relatives: the deep root is unknown.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词：更深的词根无从考证。

items.example: Rain drummed on the garbage can.
items.exampleCN: 雨点敲打着垃圾桶。

items.example: The garbage bin goes out at dawn.
items.exampleCN: 垃圾箱清晨被拿出去。

items.example: The garbageman waves every Tuesday.
items.exampleCN: 垃圾工每周二都挥手致意。

items.example: The -man suffix names workers.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -man 命名劳动者。

items.meaning: a sink device grinding food waste
items.example: A garbage disposal saves straining.
items.exampleCN: 厨余粉碎机省去沥水烦恼。

items.example: The garbage truck comes at six.
items.exampleCN: 垃圾车六点来。

items.meaning: refuse removal, or memory recovery in programs
items.example: Garbage collection runs nightly.
items.exampleCN: 垃圾清运每晚进行。

items.example: He talked garbage about the plan.
items.exampleCN: 他对这个计划胡说一通。

items.example: Cats topple the dustbin at night.
items.exampleCN: 猫夜里会把垃圾箱碰翻。

definition_zh: 花园；菜园；园圃；公园（复数，用于命名）
definition_en: a piece of ground near a house used for growing flowers, vegetables, or grass
core_image: 屋后一方被篱笆围起的土地，花开菜绿
scene: 清晨的露水还挂在番茄叶上。Grandmother weeds the garden before the sun grows strong.
sceneCN: 这里 garden 是「园圃」（第 1 个义项：屋旁种植的土地）；句意为太阳变烈之前，祖母在园圃里除草。

derivatives.zh: garden 加 -er 构成，义为「园丁；园艺爱好者」
garden 加 -ing 构成，义为「园艺活动」

senses.title: Ground for growing plants by a house
senses.definition: land by a house where flowers, grass, or vegetables are grown
senses.definitionCN: 屋旁种植花草蔬菜的土地
senses.example: The rose garden smells strongest at dusk.
senses.exampleCN: 玫瑰园在黄昏时香气最浓。
senses.why: The word names the enclosed growing ground itself, the home base of the family.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名围起的种植地本身，是词族的根基。

senses.title: Public park or plant collection
senses.titleCN: 公园；植物园（常复数命名）
senses.definition: a public place with planted displays, often in plural names
senses.definitionCN: 有植物展示的公共场所，常以复数命名
senses.example: We spent Sunday in the botanical gardens.
senses.exampleCN: 我们周日在植物园度过。
senses.why: Private pleasure-ground grew into public display, keeping the plural as a label of scale.
senses.whyCN: 私家的乐土长成公共的展示地，复数成了规模的标签。

senses.title: The act of cultivating
senses.definition: to work in a garden, growing or tending plants
senses.definitionCN: 在园圃中劳作，种植或照料植物
senses.example: He gardens every weekend, rain or shine.
senses.exampleCN: 他每个周末都打理园圃，风雨无阻。
senses.why: Place names turn into actions in English, so garden became a verb.
senses.whyCN: 英语惯于把场所名转为动作，garden 因此成为动词。

senses.title: Fertile, productive land
senses.definition: land so productive that it is compared to a garden
senses.definitionCN: 肥沃得可堪比园圃的土地
senses.example: The river valley is the garden of the province.
senses.exampleCN: 这条河谷是该省的鱼米之乡。
senses.why: A garden is the best-kept land, so fertile regions borrowed the compliment.
senses.whyCN: 园圃是被照料最好的土地，于是沃土之地借用了这顶桂冠。

senses.title: Gardening as a way of life
senses.definition: the hobby or culture of growing and tending plants
senses.definitionCN: 种植与照料植物的爱好或文化
senses.example: Gardening keeps her calm through winter.
senses.exampleCN: 园艺让她安然度过冬天。
senses.why: The verb gerundized into a lifestyle word, extending the action into identity.
senses.whyCN: 动名词把动作扩展为身份，园艺由此成为一种生活标签。

intro.en: Garden traces back through Germanic words for an enclosed yard, ultimately linked to city and civilization's own root.
intro.cn: garden 经日耳曼语的「围院」一词上溯，最终与 city、civilization 共享同一词源远亲。

items.en: Old English geard meant an enclosure, yard, or dwelling.
items.cn: 古英语 geard 意为围地、院落、居所。

items.en: A Germanic root *garda- meant an enclosed place, fence, or court.
items.cn: 日耳曼词根 *garda- 意为围起之地、篱栅、庭院。

items.en: Old Norman French gardin reinforced the horticultural sense in English.
items.cn: 古诺曼法语 gardin 强化了英语中的园艺义。

items.en: Middle English garden settled as the word for the planted enclosure.
items.cn: 中古英语 garden 稳定为「种植的围地」之意。

items.en: Modern English added the verb and public-garden uses.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了动词用法与公共园林用法。

note.en: Garden shares a root family with yard and guard, and it overlaps with park.
note.cn: garden 与 yard、guard 同属一个词根家族，并与 park 意义交叉。

entries.definitionCN: 院子；与 garden 同出 *garda- 词根
卫兵；一般认为与「围护」义同源
衣服；拼写开头相近但词源无关
公园；规模更大，设计更开阔
果园；专种果树

entries.definition: a small piece of planting ground
entries.definitionCN: 小块园地；强调地块单位

normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实词形的 garden 记忆钩子。

normal.en: Garden and yard share the Germanic root *garda-, the fence around the plot.
normal.cn: garden 与 yard 共享日耳曼词根 *garda-，即围住地块的篱笆。

normal.en: Gardener is the person, gardening is the pastime.
normal.cn: gardener 是人，gardening 是消遣。

normal.en: Botanical gardens keeps the plural, a public scale marker.
normal.cn: botanical gardens 用复数，标记公共规模。

normal.en: The garden of a province means its most fertile part.
normal.cn: the garden of a province 指最丰饶之地。

normal.en: Garden party is held on lawns, not indoors.
normal.cn: garden party 在草坪举行，不在室内。

abstract.en: See the low fence: without it, no garden, only land.
abstract.cn: 看那道矮篱笆：没有它便只有土地，没有园圃。

abstract.en: Hear the soft -den ending like soil underfoot.
abstract.cn: 词尾 -den 读来像脚下松软的泥土。

abstract.en: Two hands in dark soil is the verb sense made visible.
abstract.cn: 双手插入深色泥土，便是动词义的具象。

examples.en: The children planted beans in the school garden.
examples.cn: 孩子们在校园园圃里种下了豆子。

examples.en: She gardens to clear her head after work.
examples.cn: 她下班后打理园圃来放空头脑。

examples.en: The botanical gardens opened a new glasshouse.
examples.cn: 植物园开放了一座新温室。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「嘎登」——推开吱嘎作响的篱笆门，登进花园。

root: 日耳曼词根 *garda-（围地、篱栅）→ 古英语 geard（院落）+ 古法语 gardin → 英语 garden；与 yard、guard 同源远亲，核心是「被围起的种植地」。

sensesIntro.en: The enclosed planting ground is the base; public parks, the verb, fertile land, and garden culture branch from it.
sensesIntro.cn: 围起的种植地是基础；公园、动词、沃土与园艺文化皆由此分支。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: fenced ground turned green by hand
core.cn: 核心意象：被篱笆围起、经手变得青绿的土块

intro.en: Garden carries the fence-root across several everyday relatives.
intro.cn: garden 带着篱笆词根贯通多个日常近亲词。

latinIntro.en: The root family is Germanic; Latin cousins appear only through the wider Indo-European net.
latinIntro.cn: 词根族属日耳曼语；拉丁近亲只出现在更宽的印欧网络里。

items.example: Garda- underlies yard and garden alike.
items.exampleCN: garda- 同时是 yard 与 garden 的底根。

items.example: The yard holds the woodpile.
items.exampleCN: 院子里堆着柴垛。

items.example: A guard checked the tickets.
items.exampleCN: 检票员查了票。

items.example: The hospital ward was quiet.
items.exampleCN: 病房很安静。

items.example: The gardener pruned the hedges.
items.exampleCN: 园丁修剪了树篱。

items.example: Gardening needs patience.
items.exampleCN: 园艺需要耐心。

items.example: The -ing suffix builds activity nouns.
items.exampleCN: -ing 词尾构成活动名词。

items.example: The orchard smells of ripe plums.
items.exampleCN: 果园里飘着熟李子的香气。

items.example: She studies horticulture at college.
items.exampleCN: 她在大学学园艺。

definition_zh: 大门；登机口；闸门；（比喻）通道
definition_en: a movable barrier closing an opening in a fence or wall, or an airport exit to a plane
core_image: 一扇可开合的木门横在篱笆缺口处，锁链垂在门柱上
scene: 候机厅广播响了第三遍。Passengers for flight eight six two gathered at gate fifteen.
sceneCN: 这里 gate 是「登机口」（第 3 个义项：机场登机通道口）；句意为862次航班的旅客聚集在15号登机口。

derivatives.zh: 复合词 gate + keeper，义为「看门人；（比喻）把关者」
复合词 gate + way，义为「门口；网关；通道」

senses.title: A movable barrier in a fence or wall
senses.definition: a hinged or sliding barrier closing an opening in a wall or fence
senses.definitionCN: 装在墙或篱笆开口处、可开合的挡板
senses.example: The garden gate creaked in the north wind.
senses.exampleCN: 花园大门在北风里吱呀作响。
senses.why: The word names the physical barrier itself, the oldest and central sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名挡板本身，是最古老、居于中心的义项。

senses.title: A passage or entrance controlled by it
senses.definition: the opening or way that the barrier controls
senses.definitionCN: 由挡板控制的开口或通路
senses.example: Cattle funnel through the gate one by one.
senses.exampleCN: 牛一头一头地穿过栅门。
senses.why: The barrier and its opening blur into one label, since naming one names the passage.
senses.whyCN: 挡板与开口在命名上融为一体，叫出其一即指向通路。

senses.title: An airport exit to a plane
senses.definition: the numbered airport doorway leading passengers to a plane
senses.definitionCN: 机场内编号的旅客登机通道口
senses.example: Boarding starts forty minutes before at the gate.
senses.exampleCN: 登机前四十分钟在登机口开始。
senses.why: Airports reused the controlled-passage idea, numbering each doorway like a gate.
senses.whyCN: 机场复用「受控通道」的观念，给每个出入口编号如门。

senses.title: A mechanical or water barrier
senses.definition: a sliding barrier controlling water, electrons, or traffic
senses.definitionCN: 控制水流、电流或车流的滑动挡板
senses.example: The sluice gate lifted and the mill wheel turned.
senses.exampleCN: 水闸升起，磨坊水轮转动起来。
senses.why: The same barrier shape works for water and circuits, so the engineering sense borrowed it.
senses.whyCN: 同一种挡板形状适用于水流与电路，工程义项由此借用。

senses.title: Metaphorical opening to progress
senses.definition: a figurative entry point to a stage, career, or knowledge
senses.definitionCN: 通往某一阶段、职业或知识的比喻性入口
senses.example: Learning to read is the gate to every other subject.
senses.exampleCN: 学会阅读是通往其他所有学科之门。
senses.why: Where one passes from outside to inside, speech opens a gate, borrowing the physical image.
senses.whyCN: 凡是从外到内的跨越，言语都会开启一扇门，借用实体画面。

senses.title: To restrict access by barriers
senses.definition: to fit with a gate or limit who may pass, as gated community
senses.definitionCN: 安装门禁或限制谁可通行，如 gated community
senses.example: The lane is gated after ten at night.
senses.exampleCN: 这条巷子每晚十点后上闸。
senses.why: The noun moved into the verb slot as access control became an everyday practice.
senses.whyCN: 随着门禁成为日常，名词滑入了动词位置。

intro.en: Gate is a native Norse-influenced word for a barrier, distinct from the northern gate meaning street.
intro.cn: gate 是受诺斯语影响的「门闩」本土词，与北方方言里表示「街道」的 gate 是两回事。

items.en: Old Norse gata meant an opening, passage, or road.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 gata 意为开口、通道、道路。

items.en: Old English geat meant a gate or opening in an enclosure.
items.cn: 古英语 geat 指围栏上的门或开口。

items.en: Scandinavian settlement reinforced both the road and the barrier senses in England.
items.cn: 斯堪的纳维亚人的定居使「街道」与「门闩」两义在英格兰并存。

items.en: Middle English gate kept the barrier sense while street uses survived in place names.
items.cn: 中古英语 gate 保留门闩义，街道义留存于地名之中。

items.en: Modern English added airports, sluices, verbs, and metaphor.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了机场、水闸、动词与比喻用法。

note.en: Gate pairs with door, fence, and gatecrash; in place names it may mean street itself.
note.cn: gate 与 door、fence、gatecrash 成套出现；在地名中它可能意指街道本身。

entries.definitionCN: 步态；与 gate 同音不同义，词源无关

entries.definition: an entrance or network passage point
entries.definitionCN: 门口；网关；gate 的复合词
gate 的复数形式

entries.definition: a barrier for a building entrance
entries.definitionCN: 门；用于建筑入口
篱笆；gate 常是 fence 的开口部件
屏障；泛指阻挡物

normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实用法的 gate 记忆钩子。

normal.en: Gate and gait sound alike: the gate swings, the gait strides.
normal.cn: gate 与 gait 同音：门会摆动，步态会迈步。

normal.en: Gatekeeper is literal and metaphorical at once.
normal.cn: gatekeeper 字面与比喻义并存。

normal.en: Airport gate numbers follow boarding order.
normal.cn: 机场登机口的编号配合登机顺序。

normal.en: Northern place names ending in -gate often mean street.
normal.cn: 北方地名以 -gate 结尾多半意指街道。

normal.en: A gated community is a neighbourhood locked by gates.
normal.cn: gated community 就是用门禁锁住的小区。

abstract.en: Hinge, post, chain: the moving triangle of every gate.
abstract.cn: 铰链、门柱、锁链：每一扇门的运动三角。

abstract.en: Passing a gate feels like crossing into a new chapter.
abstract.cn: 穿过大门像跨入新篇章。

abstract.en: Water pushing against a sluice gate is power held back.
abstract.cn: 水压闸门是被拦住的势能。

examples.en: He left the bike outside the garden gate.
examples.cn: 他把自行车停在花园大门外。

examples.en: The gate for flight two one nine is changing.
examples.cn: 219次航班的登机口有变动。

examples.en: They gated the alley to stop theft.
examples.cn: 他们给小巷装了门禁以防盗窃。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「盖特」——盖子上有特制的门闩，这就是大门。

root: 古英语 geat（围栏开口）与古诺斯语 gata（通道、道路）互相影响；核心意象是「受控的开口」，街道义保留在地名中。

sensesIntro.en: The physical barrier is central; passages, boarding doors, sluices, metaphors, and access control hang from it.
sensesIntro.cn: 实体门闩居于中心；通道、登机口、闸门、比喻与门禁都由它引出。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a controlled opening in a wall of fence
core.cn: 核心意象：墙篱上受控的开口

intro.en: Gate compounds freely and leaves -gate in northern street names.
intro.cn: gate 构词能力很强，北方地名中的 -gate 是它留下的印记。

latinIntro.en: There are no Latin relatives: gate is a Germanic and Norse word.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词：gate 属日耳曼与诺斯语系统。

items.example: Geat is the Old English ancestor.
items.exampleCN: geat 是古英语的祖先形式。

items.example: Gata survives in street names like Briggate.
items.exampleCN: gata 留存于 Briggate 等街名中。

items.example: Editors are gatekeepers of news.
items.exampleCN: 编辑是新闻的把关人。

items.example: A gateway router links the networks.
items.exampleCN: 网关路由器连接各网络。

items.example: Fans tried to gatecrash the final.
items.exampleCN: 球迷试图闯入决赛现场。

items.example: The sluice gate opened at noon.
items.exampleCN: 水闸中午开启。

items.example: They moved to a gated community.
items.exampleCN: 他们搬进了设门禁的小区。

items.example: The -keeper suffix names custodians.
items.exampleCN: -keeper 词尾命名看管者。

items.example: The horse has a smooth gait.
items.exampleCN: 这匹马步态平稳。

definition_zh: 总的；普遍的；大致的；将军；普通民众
definition_en: concerning all or most cases, not specific or detailed, or a top army officer
core_image: 鸟瞰整个战场的高地指挥台：既见全局，也见执旗的将军
scene: 战报室里地图铺满整面墙。The general studied the front line before giving any order.
sceneCN: 这里 general 是「将军」（第 5 个义项：高级军官）；句意为将军在下达任何命令前先研究前线态势。

derivatives.zh: general 加 -ly 构成，义为「通常；大体上」
general 加 -ize 构成，义为「概括；推广到一般」
generalize 的名词形式，义为「概括；泛化结论」

senses.title: Covering all or most cases
senses.definition: including or affecting all or most people, things, or cases
senses.definitionCN: 包含或影响所有人、物或情形
senses.example: There is general agreement on the new rules.
senses.exampleCN: 人们对新规则已有普遍共识。
senses.why: The Latin root means of a kind or class, so the covering-everything sense is the oldest layer.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为「属于同一类」，因此「覆盖全体」是最古老的意义层。

senses.title: Not detailed or specific
senses.definition: giving the main points without going into detail
senses.definitionCN: 只给要点、不展开细节
senses.example: She gave a general outline of the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 她给出了计划的大致轮廓。
senses.why: Looking at the whole rather than the parts yields the rough-sketch sense.
senses.whyCN: 看整体而非局部，便得到「粗线条」这一义项。

senses.title: Higher in rank, as general manager
senses.definition: having overall responsibility, as in general manager
senses.definitionCN: 负有全面职责，如总经理
senses.example: The general manager signs every contract.
senses.exampleCN: 每一份合同都由总经理签署。
senses.why: One who oversees the whole class of affairs is placed over it, extending the covering sense to rank.
senses.whyCN: 统管一类事务的人被置于其上，「覆盖」义由此延伸到职务层级。

senses.title: The ordinary public
senses.definition: ordinary people, as in the general public
senses.definitionCN: 普通人们，如 the general public
senses.example: The museum opens its doors to the general public on Fridays.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆每逢周五向公众开放。
senses.why: The broad mass is contrasted with the specialist few, so the crowd receives the general label.
senses.whyCN: 广大人群与少数专家相对，于是大众获得了「一般」的标签。

senses.title: A top army officer
senses.definition: an officer of the highest army rank above colonel
senses.definitionCN: 陆军中高于上校的最高级军官
senses.example: The general reviewed the troops at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 将军在拂晓检阅部队。
senses.why: The officer in charge of the whole army took the name of the whole itself, general.
senses.whyCN: 统率全军者以「全体」之名为衔，即 general（将军）。

senses.title: Generalize to a rule
senses.definition: to form a wide rule from single cases, as a verb use
senses.definitionCN: 从个别情形形成普遍规则的动词用法
senses.example: Do not generalize from one bad experience.
senses.exampleCN: 不要凭一次糟糕经历就下一般性结论。
senses.why: Pulling particulars into one class is the Latin sense in motion, so the verb was formed.
senses.whyCN: 把个别收拢为一类正是拉丁词根义的运动形式，动词由此造出。

intro.en: General comes from Latin genus, the race or kind of a thing, later carried through French into English.
intro.cn: general 来自拉丁语 genus（种属），后经法语进入英语。

items.en: Latin genus meant birth, race, kind, and gave the stem gener-.
items.cn: 拉丁语 genus 意为出生、种族、种类，给出词干 gener-。

items.en: Latin generalis meant belonging to a whole class or kind.
items.cn: 拉丁语 generalis 意为「属于整个类别」。

items.en: Old French general passed the adjective into learned and everyday use.
items.cn: 古法语 general 把这一形容词带入书面与日常使用。

items.en: Middle English borrowed it for general, overall, and widespread.
items.cn: 中古英语借入它表示总体的、全面的、普遍的。

items.en: The army rank arose because the officer commanded the whole body of troops.
items.cn: 军衔义源于该军官统率整支军队，故称 general。

items.en: Modern English added the adverb, the verb generalize, and the public sense.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了副词、动词 generalize 与大众义。

note.en: General splits into an adjective of breadth and a noun of rank, with generate family nearby.
note.cn: general 分为「广度」形容词与「军衔」名词，generate 词族就在近旁。

entries.definitionCN: 通常；大体上；general 的副词形式
产生；同出 genus 词根的动词
真正的；一般认为与 genus（出身）同根
全面的；与 general 的总括义重叠
普遍的；范围更大
具体的；general 的反义

normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实用法的 general 记忆钩子。

normal.en: Latin genus means kind, and generalis means of the whole kind.
normal.cn: 拉丁 genus 意为种属，generalis 意为属于整个类别。

normal.en: In general is the opener of most summarizing sentences.
normal.cn: in general 是多数总结句的开场白。

normal.en: A general commands the general body of troops, hence the rank.
normal.cn: general（将军）统率全体军队，军衔由此得名。

normal.en: General manager sits above every branch manager.
normal.cn: general manager 位于各部门经理之上。

normal.en: General knowledge is what most people can be expected to know.
normal.cn: general knowledge 指多数人理应知道的常识。

abstract.en: Climb the hill above the battlefield: the whole becomes visible.
abstract.cn: 登上战场之上的高地：全局一览无余。

abstract.en: A rough pencil sketch before the detailed map is general before specific.
abstract.cn: 详图之前的铅笔粗稿，就是 general 先于 specific。

abstract.en: One flag among many flags: the general among officers.
abstract.cn: 众旗之中的一面帅旗：军官群中的将军。

examples.en: In general, students learn faster in small groups.
examples.cn: 总体而言，学生在小组里学得更快。

examples.en: The general ordered the bridge to be held at all costs.
examples.cn: 将军下令不惜代价守住桥。

examples.en: Give me a general idea of your budget first.
examples.cn: 先给我一个预算的大致概念。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「简奴罗」——将军简奴罗不看细节只看全局。

root: 拉丁 genus（种属、出生）→ generalis（属于全类的）→ 古法语 general → 英语 general；与 generate、genuine、genetic 同属 genus 词族。

sensesIntro.en: Belonging to the whole class is the root sense; roughness, rank, the public, and the verb branch from it.
sensesIntro.cn: 「属于全类」是词根义；粗略、军衔、大众与动词用法都从它分出。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the whole class seen from above
core.cn: 核心意象：从高处俯瞰的整个类别

intro.en: The genus root powers one of English's largest word families.
intro.cn: genus 词根驱动着英语中最大的词族之一。

latinIntro.en: Latin relatives keep the birth-and-kind stem alive everywhere.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁同源词让「出生与种属」词干无处不在。

items.example: Genus still names biological categories.
items.exampleCN: genus 至今用于生物分类学。

items.example: Generalis is the direct parent of general.
items.exampleCN: generalis 是 general 的直接来源。

items.example: Generally, sales rise in December.
items.exampleCN: 通常十二月的销售会上升。

items.example: Children generalize rules from examples.
items.exampleCN: 孩子从例子中概括规律。

items.example: The -ize suffix builds verbs freely.
items.exampleCN: -ize 后缀能自由构成动词。

items.meaning: a stage of descent or producing
items.example: The new generation prefers streaming.
items.exampleCN: 新一代偏爱流媒体。

items.example: Wind turbines generate electricity.
items.exampleCN: 风力涡轮发电。

items.meaningCN: 真正的；一般认为源自 genus（出身）
items.example: This is genuine silk.
items.exampleCN: 这是真丝。

items.example: Genetic tests now guide treatment.
items.exampleCN: 基因检测如今指导治疗。

definition_zh: 温和的；轻柔的；出身高贵的；驯服的
definition_en: kind, mild, and careful, or belonging to a family of high social standing
core_image: 一只手轻轻托起受伤的小鸟，怕惊扰了它
scene: 雨停了，屋檐还在滴水。A gentle breeze dried the washing without knocking it down.
sceneCN: 这里 gentle 是「轻柔的」（第 2 个义项：力量不猛烈）；句意为一阵轻柔的微风晾干了衣物，却没把它吹落。

pos.zh: 温和的；轻柔的；出身高贵的

derivatives.zh: gentle 加 -ly 构成，义为「轻柔地；温和地」
gentle 加 -ness 构成，义为「温和；温文」
gentle + man 构成，义为「绅士；先生」

senses.title: Kind and considerate in manner
senses.definition: kind and careful not to hurt or upset others
senses.definitionCN: 和善且小心不伤害或冒犯他人
senses.example: The nurse spoke in a gentle voice to the old man.
senses.exampleCN: 护士用温柔的声音对老人说话。
senses.why: High-born people were expected to be well-mannered, so refined behaviour became the human sense.
senses.whyCN: 出身高贵者被期待举止有教养，于是「有教养的举止」成为关于人的核心义。

senses.title: Not forceful or strong
senses.definition: mild in force, movement, or degree
senses.definitionCN: 力量、运动或程度上的轻微不猛烈
senses.example: She gave the rope a gentle pull.
senses.exampleCN: 她轻轻拉了一下绳子。
senses.why: The refined touch of a trained hand transfers to any mild force, wind, slope, or soap.
senses.whyCN: 受训之手的文雅触碰转移到一切轻微力量上，如微风、缓坡、温和的肥皂。

senses.title: Well-born, of good family
senses.definition: belonging to a family of high social rank
senses.definitionCN: 出身于社会地位高的家庭
senses.example: In old tales only gentle blood could ride in tournaments.
senses.exampleCN: 在古老的故事里，只有高贵血统才能参加骑士比武。
senses.why: This is the word's original sense, social rank, later softened into manners.
senses.whyCN: 这是词的本义——社会等级，后来软化成举止义。

senses.title: Tamed and easy to handle
senses.definition: docile and not wild, as of animals
senses.definitionCN: 温顺不野性，用于动物
senses.example: The gentle mare let the children brush her.
senses.exampleCN: 温顺的母马任由孩子们刷毛。
senses.why: A creature taught by gentle hands becomes gentle, closing the circle of the word.
senses.whyCN: 被温柔之手调教的生灵变得温顺，词义在此完成闭环。

senses.title: To calm or tame someone
senses.definition: to make someone calmer or less angry, especially a horse
senses.definitionCN: 使某人平静或缓和怒气，尤指驯马
senses.example: The trainer gentled the young colt in a week.
senses.exampleCN: 驯马师一周内驯服了小马。
senses.why: The adjective turned verb names the act of producing gentleness.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转动词，命名「制造温柔」的行为。

senses.title: Gradual and moderate in change
senses.definition: changing slowly and not steeply, as slopes or curves
senses.definitionCN: 坡度或曲线变化缓慢而不陡峭
senses.example: The path follows a gentle rise to the ridge.
senses.exampleCN: 小路沿着一段平缓的坡升上山脊。
senses.why: Small force produces small change, so gentle describes the mildest gradients.
senses.whyCN: 小力量造成小变化，gentle 因此描述最平缓的梯度。

intro.en: Gentle descends from Latin gentilis, meaning of the same clan, later refined in French.
intro.cn: gentle 源自拉丁语 gentilis（同族的），后经法语精细化。

items.en: Latin gens meant clan, and gentilis meant belonging to the same clan.
items.cn: 拉丁语 gens 意为氏族，gentilis 意为同氏族的。

items.en: Gentilis also translated Greek for foreign nations, gentile.
items.cn: gentilis 还用于翻译希腊语的「异邦人」，即 gentile。

items.en: Old French gentil meant noble, well-born, and refined.
items.cn: 古法语 gentil 意为高贵的、出身好的、有教养的。

items.en: Middle English gentil covered birth, manners, and even the gentle folk as a class.
items.cn: 中古英语 gentil 兼指出身、举止，甚至作为一个阶层的「上等人」。

items.en: Modern English split off gentleman, gentile, and genteel from the same stem.
items.cn: 现代英语从同一词干分出 gentleman、gentile 与 genteel。

note.en: Gentle, genteel, and gentile are triplets from one Latin parent, and soft is its everyday rival.
note.cn: gentle、genteel、gentile 是同一拉丁父母的三个孩子，soft 是它的日常对手。

entries.definition: polite in a showy, old-fashioned way
entries.definitionCN: 斯文做作的；同根的旧式礼貌词

entries.definition: a person not of the Jewish faith
entries.definitionCN: 非犹太人；同根但语义转向宗教
轻柔地；gentle 的副词

友善的；强调善意
柔软的；偏重触感与音量

normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实词形的 gentle 记忆钩子。

normal.en: Latin gens means clan, so gentle once meant born of a good clan.
normal.cn: 拉丁 gens 意为氏族，gentle 曾指「出自好氏族」。

normal.en: Gentle and gentile differ by one letter and one thousand years of meaning.
normal.cn: gentle 与 gentile 只差一个字母，词义却分道一千年。

normal.en: A gentle slope rises slowly, keeping the mild-force idea.
normal.cn: gentle slope 缓缓上升，保留「力量轻微」之意。

normal.en: Gentle giant pairs huge size with soft manners.
normal.cn: gentle giant 把巨大身躯与柔软举止配对。

normal.en: Be gentle with the puppy, one phrase children hear daily.
normal.cn: be gentle with the puppy 是孩子天天听到的叮嘱。

abstract.en: A hand cupped around a moth, touching without pressing.
abstract.cn: 手掌环住飞蛾，触碰而不按压。

abstract.en: Hear the soft g like a whisper at the start of the word.
abstract.cn: 词首软音 g 像一声耳语。

abstract.en: A candle flame that bends in the faintest draught.
abstract.cn: 烛火在微风中轻轻弯腰。

examples.en: Hold the kitten gently with both hands.
examples.cn: 用双手轻轻抱住小猫。

examples.en: The gentle rain did the garden good.
examples.cn: 温柔的春雨对园子大有好处。

examples.en: He was gentle with the frightened horse.
examples.cn: 他对受惊的马十分温柔。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「尖头」——温柔的人连说话都是尖头软语的。

root: 拉丁 gens（氏族）→ gentilis（同族的）→ 古法语 gentil（高贵的）→ 英语 gentle；词义路线：高贵出身 → 有教养 → 温柔轻柔；与 genteel、gentile 同源。

sensesIntro.en: Good birth is the starting point; soft force, animals, calming, and slow gradients branch from it.
sensesIntro.cn: 良好出身是起点；轻柔之力、驯化、安抚与缓坡都由此分支。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a trained hand that touches without hurting
core.cn: 核心意象：触碰而不伤害的教养之手

branches.en: small, mild amounts of force or change

intro.en: Gentle anchors a triple branch of the gens family in English.
intro.cn: gentle 是 gens 词族在英语中的三叉分支之一。

latinIntro.en: Latin relatives keep the clan-and-birth stem visible.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁同源词让「氏族与出生」词干清晰可见。

items.example: Gens named Roman family groups.
items.exampleCN: gens 曾指罗马家族集团。

items.example: Gentilis is the shared parent of the triplets.
items.exampleCN: gentilis 是三胞胎词的共同父母。

items.example: Her genteel accent fooled no one.
items.exampleCN: 她做作的口音骗不了谁。

items.example: The gentile nations appear in old maps of belief.
items.exampleCN: 旧信仰地图上标注着外邦民族。

items.example: She closed the door gently.
items.exampleCN: 她轻轻关上门。

items.example: His gentleness calmed the baby.
items.exampleCN: 他的温柔安抚了婴儿。

items.example: He is a true gentleman.
items.exampleCN: 他是真正的绅士。

items.example: The gentlewoman attended the court.
items.exampleCN: 贵妇侍立于宫廷。

items.example: The gentry owned the river meadows.
items.exampleCN: 乡绅拥有河畔草场。

definition_zh: 绅士；先生；有教养的男人；（称呼）各位先生
definition_en: a courteous, well-mannered man, or a polite way to address or mention men
core_image: 为身后的人扶住玻璃门、微微颔首的男子
scene: 咖啡馆门开了又合，风铃轻响。A gentleman held the door for the mother with two children.
sceneCN: 这里 gentleman 是「绅士」（第 1 个义项：彬彬有礼的男人）；句意为一位绅士为带着两个孩子的母亲扶住了门。

pos.zh: 绅士；先生；有身份的男子

derivatives.zh: gentleman 加 -ly 构成，义为「绅士派的；有绅士风度的」
gentle + woman 构成，义为「贵妇；有身份的女子」

senses.title: A courteous, well-mannered man
senses.definition: a man who is polite and behaves well towards others
senses.definitionCN: 待人礼貌、举止得体的男人
senses.example: Only a gentleman returns the extra change.
senses.exampleCN: 只有绅士才会把多找的零钱退回去。
senses.why: Good birth once promised good manners, so the rank word became the behaviour word.
senses.whyCN: 好的出身曾预示好的举止，等级词由此变成行为词。

senses.title: A man of good social standing
senses.definition: a man of good family or social position
senses.definitionCN: 家世或社会地位良好的男人
senses.example: The estate passed to a wealthy gentleman.
senses.exampleCN: 庄园传给了一位富裕的乡绅。
senses.why: This is the older half of the word, rank before manners.
senses.whyCN: 这是词的较旧一半——先有等级，后有举止。

senses.title: A polite way to address a man
senses.definition: a polite word for any man, often with this or that
senses.definitionCN: 对任何男性的礼貌称呼，常与 this、that 连用
senses.example: This gentleman was here first.
senses.exampleCN: 这位先生先到的。
senses.why: Honorifics borrow the rank word to honour strangers politely.
senses.whyCN: 敬称借用等级词来礼貌地抬高陌生人。

senses.title: Men as a group in speeches
senses.definition: men addressed collectively in formal speech
senses.definitionCN: 正式讲话中对男性听众的集体称呼
senses.example: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome aboard.
senses.exampleCN: 女士们、先生们，欢迎登机。
senses.why: The plural ranks the whole room politely, a speech-hall formula.
senses.whyCN: 复数形式礼貌地统称全场，是演讲厅的固定程式。

senses.title: A man who does not need to work
senses.definition: a man of independent means, not a manual worker
senses.definitionCN: 有独立资产、不事体力劳作的男人
senses.example: He lived as a gentleman on rents from the estate.
senses.exampleCN: 他靠庄园租金过着绅士生活。
senses.why: Rank without labour defined the old gentry, so leisure marked the gentleman.
senses.whyCN: 旧乡绅以「有产而无劳」定义，悠闲成了绅士的标志。

intro.en: Gentleman is a compound of gentle and man, first written for men of noble birth.
intro.cn: gentleman 是 gentle 与 man 的复合词，最初记录用于指贵族出身的男子。

items.en: Old French gentil supplied the noble half of the compound.
items.cn: 古法语 gentil 提供了复合词中「高贵」的一半。

items.en: Old English mann supplied the person half.
items.cn: 古英语 mann 提供了「人」的一半。

items.en: Middle English gentil man meant a man of good family.
items.cn: 中古英语 gentil man 指家世良好的男子。

items.en: The sense slid from birth to manners across the fifteenth century.
items.cn: 十五世纪前后词义从出身滑向举止。

items.en: Modern English fixed gentleman as courteous man and polite address.
items.cn: 现代英语把 gentleman 定型为「有礼的男士」与敬称。

note.en: Gentleman, sir, and lord divide the politeness field among them.
note.cn: gentleman、sir、lord 分占了礼貌用语的不同领地。

entries.definitionCN: 无赖；粗鲁男子，gentleman 的反义形象

normal.en: Gentle plus man equals a man of gentle manners.

normal.en: The plural is irregular: gentlemen, not gentlemans.

normal.en: Ladies and gentlemen opens nearly every formal speech.

normal.en: A gentleman's agreement needs no paper, only trust.

normal.en: Gentleman farmer owns the land but rents the labour.

abstract.en: Hear the soft hat tip: one small bow of the head.
abstract.cn: 听不见的脱帽礼：一次轻轻的颔首。

abstract.en: An old coat with clean cuffs: rank gone, manners left.
abstract.cn: 袖口干净的旧大衣：等级已逝，教养犹存。

examples.cn: 在整个争执中他的表现堪称绅士。

examples.en: Ladies and gentlemen, the train is now arriving.

examples.cn: 那位老先生每天中午喂鸽子。

sensesIntro.en: Manners are the modern center; rank, polite address, collective speech, and leisure rank branch behind it.
sensesIntro.cn: 举止是现代词义中心；等级、敬称、集体称呼与有闲阶层在其背后分支。

definition_zh: 地理学；某地区的地形与地理状况
definition_en: the study of the earth's places, environments, and spatial patterns, or the arrangement of features in a region
core_image: 一张铺开的世界地图，山脉、河流与城市以符号标出
scene: 课堂上，老师把一张世界地图展开，让学生找山脉与河流的位置： She studied geography to understand why cities grow along rivers.
sceneCN: 这里 geography 指「研究地表与空间格局的学科」（第 1 个义项：以地球表面、环境与空间分布为对象的学科）；句意为她学地理，是为了理解城市为何沿河生长。

pos.zh: 地理学；地理状况（学科义不可数，地区状况义可数）

forms.label: 复数（指不同地区的地理状况）

senses.title: The academic study of places
senses.titleCN: 研究地方与空间的学科
senses.definition: the discipline that studies the earth's surface, environments, and the spatial organization of human and natural features
senses.definitionCN: 研究地球表面、环境以及人类与自然要素空间组织的学科
senses.example: She studied geography to understand why cities grow along rivers.
senses.exampleCN: 她学地理，是为了理解城市为何沿河生长。
senses.why: Geo- means earth and -graphy means writing or description; the subject began as a written account of the known world.
senses.whyCN: geo- 意为「大地」，-graphy 意为「书写、描述」；这门学科最初是对已知世界的书面记述。

senses.title: The physical arrangement of a region
senses.titleCN: 某地区的地形与地理状况
senses.definition: the actual layout of landforms, water, climate, and settlement in a particular area
senses.definitionCN: 某一地区地貌、水体、气候与聚落的具体布局
senses.example: The geography of the valley made the road expensive to build.
senses.exampleCN: 这条山谷的地理状况使修路成本高昂。
senses.why: The subject and its object share a name: what geography studies is also called its geography.
senses.whyCN: 学科与其对象同名：地理学研究的东西也被称作它的「地理状况」。

senses.title: A school subject
senses.definition: the school subject that teaches maps, places, climates, and peoples
senses.definitionCN: 教授地图、地方、气候与人群的学校科目
senses.example: Geography was his favourite class because of the maps.
senses.exampleCN: 地理是他最喜欢的课，因为有很多地图。
senses.why: Once a research field enters the classroom, its name names the lesson as well as the discipline.
senses.whyCN: 研究领域进入课堂后，其名称既指学科，也指课程。

senses.title: Human geography
senses.definition: the branch that studies people, economies, cities, and cultures in space
senses.definitionCN: 研究人、经济、城市与文化在空间中分布的分支
senses.example: Human geography explains why the border town grew so fast.
senses.exampleCN: 人文地理解释了这座边贸城镇为何发展如此快。
senses.why: The field split into natural and human halves, and each half keeps the parent name with a qualifier.
senses.whyCN: 该领域分为自然与人文两半，每一半都保留母名并加上限定词。

senses.title: Physical geography
senses.definition: the branch that studies landforms, climate, water, soils, and ecosystems
senses.definitionCN: 研究地貌、气候、水、土壤与生态系统的分支
senses.example: Physical geography links the mountain range to the rainfall pattern.
senses.exampleCN: 自然地理把山脉与降水格局联系起来。
senses.why: The physical half keeps the older earth-description tradition, measuring what can be mapped.
senses.whyCN: 自然地理一半延续较早的地表描述传统，测量可被制图的东西。

senses.title: Economic and commercial geography
senses.definition: the study of where production, trade, and markets are located and why
senses.definitionCN: 研究生产、贸易与市场位于何处及其原因
senses.example: The company hired a specialist in economic geography.
senses.exampleCN: 公司聘请了一位经济地理专家。
senses.why: Location is a cost, so business needs a map of advantages; geography supplies that map.
senses.whyCN: 位置即成本，企业需要一张优势地图，而地理学提供这张图。

senses.title: The spatial pattern of anything
senses.definition: the distribution and arrangement of a phenomenon across space, used figuratively
senses.definitionCN: 某一现象在空间中的分布与排列，作比喻使用
senses.example: The geography of the market changed when the highway opened.
senses.exampleCN: 高速公路开通后，市场的空间格局改变了。
senses.why: The metaphor treats abstract advantages as terrain: some places are close, some are distant, and the shape matters.
senses.whyCN: 这一比喻把抽象优势当作地形：有的地方近，有的地方远，形状很重要。

senses.title: A written description of the earth
senses.titleCN: 对地球的书面描述（历史义）
senses.definition: the older sense of a written account of lands, peoples, and natural features
senses.definitionCN: 较古老的含义：对土地、民族与自然特征的书面记述
senses.example: The old geography described coasts the author had never seen.
senses.exampleCN: 那部旧地理志描述了作者从未见过的海岸。
senses.why: -Graphy is 'writing', so geography first meant earth-writing before it meant earth-science.
senses.whyCN: -graphy 是「书写」，因此 geography 先指「书写大地」，后指「地球科学」。

senses.title: Abstract: the lay of the land
senses.definition: the overall shape of a situation, including its high ground and obstacles
senses.definitionCN: 某一局势的整体形状，包括其高地与障碍
senses.example: Before the negotiation, they studied the geography of the room.
senses.exampleCN: 谈判前，他们研究了这间屋子里的局势地形。
senses.why: Politics borrows terrain words because advantage depends on position; the metaphor turns interests into landscape.
senses.whyCN: 政治借用 terrain 类词，因为优势取决于位置；比喻把利益关系变成地貌。

intro.en: Geography comes from Greek through Latin, literally 'earth-writing'. The Greek elements are clear; the origin of ge is not. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: geography 经拉丁语来自希腊语，字面是「书写大地」。希腊语素清楚，但 ge 的来源不明。年代均为约数。

items.en: Ge meant 'earth, land'. Its origin is uncertain and it is often treated as a pre-Greek word, so proposed Indo-European roots are reconstructions.
items.cn: ge 意为「大地、土地」。其来源不确定，常被视为前希腊语词，因此为它提出的印欧词根都属重构形式。

items.en: Graphein meant 'to write, draw, scratch'. Geography is earth-writing, a description rather than an experiment.
items.cn: graphein 意为「写、画、刻」。geography 就是「书写大地」，是描述而非实验。

items.en: Geographia named a written description of the inhabited world, as in the title of Ptolemy's work.
items.cn: geographia 指对已知有人居住世界的书面描述，托勒密著作的标题即用此词。

items.en: Latin kept the Greek word, and English borrowed it in the fifteenth century for descriptions of lands and peoples.
items.cn: 拉丁语保留了这个希腊词，英语在 15 世纪借入，用于描述土地与民族。

items.en: In the nineteenth century geography became a university discipline with physical and human branches; the exact founding date varies by country.
items.cn: 19 世纪地理学成为设有自然与人文分支的大学学科，其确切创立年代因国而异。

note.en: Group one holds forms and near-spellings from the same Greek stock; group two holds fields and words often confused with geography.
note.cn: 第一组是同出希腊语词干的形式与近拼写词；第二组是常与地理学混淆的学科与词。

entries.definition: Relating to geography; it describes a distribution or feature rather than naming the discipline.
entries.definitionCN: 与地理学相关的；它描述分布或特征，而非命名学科。

entries.definition: A person who studies geography; the -er ending marks the practitioner.
entries.definitionCN: 研究地理学的人；-er 结尾标记从业者。

entries.definition: The study of rocks and the earth's interior; geography studies surface places, not deep structure.
entries.definitionCN: 研究岩石与地球内部的学科；地理学研究地表地方，而非深部结构。

entries.definition: The detailed arrangement of surface features, especially elevation; geography is the broader study.
entries.definitionCN: 地表特征尤其是高程的细致排列；地理学是更广的研究。

entries.definition: The art and science of making maps; it is a tool of geography, not the whole field.
entries.definitionCN: 制作地图的艺术与科学；它是地理学的工具，而非整个领域。

entries.definition: The study of how location and resources shape politics; it applies geography to power.
entries.definitionCN: 研究位置与资源如何塑造政治；它把地理学应用于权力。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Greek morphemes, real academic terms and real collocations, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实希腊语素、真实学科术语与真实搭配，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Geo- is earth; -graphy is writing: geography is earth-writing.
normal.cn: geo- 是大地，-graphy 是书写：geography 就是书写大地。

normal.en: The family runs geography, geographer, geographic, geographical, geographically.
normal.cn: 词族包括 geography、geographer、geographic、geographical、geographically。

normal.en: Geography splits into physical and human halves.
normal.cn: 地理学分为自然与人文两半。

normal.en: Maps are its signature tool, but spatial reasoning is its method.
normal.cn: 地图是它的标志工具，空间推理则是它的方法。

normal.en: Geography and geology differ: surface places versus deep rocks.
normal.cn: geography 与 geology 不同：前者管地表地方，后者管深部岩石。

abstract.en: Picture a chessboard where the squares themselves change shape.
abstract.cn: 想象一张棋盘，格子本身还会改变形状。

abstract.en: Picture a room whose walls decide who can hear whom.
abstract.cn: 想象一间屋子，墙壁决定谁能听见谁。

abstract.en: Picture a market drawn as a landscape of hills and rivers.
abstract.cn: 想象一个市场被画成山丘与河流构成的地貌。

examples.en: She studied geography to understand why cities grow along rivers.
examples.cn: 她学地理，是为了理解城市为何沿河生长。

examples.en: The geography of the island keeps its villages close to the coast.
examples.cn: 这座岛的地理状况使村庄都靠近海岸。

examples.en: Economic geography explains where factories cluster.
examples.cn: 经济地理解释工厂为何聚集在某些地方。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「geo（大地）+ graphy（书写）」——把大地的样子写下来 → 地理学

root: 拉丁语 geographia，来自希腊语 geographia = ge「大地」+ graphein「书写、描画」。ge 的来源不确定，常视为前希腊语词；graphein 的词根清楚。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses move from the discipline to its object, its classroom, its branches, its business use, its spatial metaphor, its old descriptive sense, and finally to the shape of any situation.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项从学科走到其对象、课堂、分支、商业用途、空间比喻、古老描述义，最后落到任何局势的形状。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a world map spread open, its mountains, rivers and cities marked with symbols.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张铺开的世界地图，山脉、河流与城市用符号标出。

branches.en: WRITING AND STUDY: description of the earth grew into a disciplined study of it.
branches.cn: 书写与研究：对地球的描述发展为对它的系统研究。

branches.en: FIELD AND CLASSROOM: the same name covers the researcher's object and the pupil's lesson.
branches.cn: 研究对象与课堂：同一名称既指研究者的对象，也指学生的课程。

branches.en: TWO HALVES: human and physical branches divide the field without replacing its name.
branches.cn: 两半：人文与自然分支把领域分开，却未取代其名称。

branches.en: LOCATION AS VALUE: business and metaphor both read space as advantage and cost.
branches.cn: 位置即价值：商业与比喻都把空间读作优势与成本。

branches.en: ROOM AS TERRAIN: a situation acquires high ground, obstacles and distance.
branches.cn: 房间即地形：局势也有了高地、障碍与距离。

intro.en: Geography is built from two productive Greek elements, and its derivatives fill out a whole academic family.
intro.cn: geography 由两个多产的希腊语素构成，其派生词撑起整个学术词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin geographia is the borrowed form; Greek ge and graphein are the ultimate elements.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 geographia 是借入形式；希腊语 ge 与 graphein 是最终语素。

items.example: Ge- opens geography, geology and geometry.
items.exampleCN: ge- 出现在 geography、geology 与 geometry 开头。

items.example: -Graphy appears in biography and cartography.
items.exampleCN: -graphy 见于 biography 与 cartography。

items.example: Geography studies places and spatial patterns.
items.exampleCN: 地理学研究地方与空间格局。

items.meaningCN: 研究地方的人；地理学家
items.example: The geographer mapped the flood plain.
items.exampleCN: 地理学家绘制了洪泛区地图。

items.example: The two towns show a sharp geographic contrast.
items.exampleCN: 两座城镇呈现鲜明的地理对比。

items.meaningCN: 较完整的地理形容词形式
items.example: The society publishes geographical surveys.
items.exampleCN: 该学会出版地理调查报告。

items.example: The country is geographically isolated.
items.exampleCN: 这个国家在地理上很孤立。

items.meaningCN: 研究地球岩石的学科；地质学
items.example: Geology studies the deep structure, not just the surface.
items.exampleCN: 地质学研究深部结构，而不只是地表。

items.meaningCN: 受位置塑造的政治；地缘政治
items.example: Geopolitics treats borders as geography.
items.exampleCN: 地缘政治把边界当作地理。

definition_zh: 得到；收到；变得；到达；理解；说服
definition_en: to obtain, receive, become, reach, or cause something to happen
core_image: 伸手一抓，东西从别处落到自己手里
scene: 信箱盖啪嗒一声合上。Did you get my letter from last Friday?
sceneCN: 这里 get 是「收到」（第 2 个义项：接收某人送来的东西）；句意为你收到我上周五的信了吗？

collocations.zh: 把事情办好；让人做某事

derivatives.zh: get + away 复合名词，义为「逃走；（度假）去处」
get 加 -er 构成，义为「获取者」

senses.title: To obtain or come to have
senses.definition: to come to have or hold something, by effort or chance
senses.definitionCN: 通过努力或机缘拥有某物
senses.example: She got a new bike for her birthday.
senses.exampleCN: 她生日得到了一辆新自行车。
senses.why: The core image is a hand closing on something, so possession is the first sense.
senses.whyCN: 核心画面是手抓握东西，因此「拥有」是第一义项。

senses.title: To receive something sent or given
senses.definition: to have something delivered, sent, or offered to you
senses.definitionCN: 接收别人送达、寄来或给予的东西
senses.example: I get about twenty emails a day.
senses.exampleCN: 我每天收到大约二十封邮件。
senses.why: What arrives in your hand you have got, so reception merges with possession.
senses.whyCN: 落到手里的东西即是「得到」，接收与拥有合并。

senses.title: To become, or cause to become
senses.definition: to change state, or to make something change state
senses.definitionCN: 状态发生变化，或使某物变化
senses.example: The room gets dark very early in winter.
senses.exampleCN: 冬天的房间黑得很早。
senses.why: A change arrives at a new state the way goods arrive in hand, so becoming reuses the arrival image.
senses.whyCN: 状态变化如同货物到手，于是「变得」复用「抵达」的画面。

senses.title: To arrive at a place
senses.definition: to reach a place or destination
senses.definitionCN: 抵达某地或目的地
senses.example: We got to the station just in time.
senses.exampleCN: 我们正好及时赶到车站。
senses.why: Movement ends in the hand of the destination, so reaching a place is arrival in the same frame.
senses.whyCN: 运动终结于目的地的「手心」，到达与到手共用同一框架。

senses.title: To understand
senses.definition: to understand something said or done
senses.definitionCN: 理解所说或所做之事
senses.example: I do not get the joke, explain it again.
senses.exampleCN: 我没听懂这个笑话，再讲一遍。
senses.why: Ideas travel to the mind like objects to the hand, so catching a meaning is getting it.
senses.whyCN: 想法像物体一样落入头脑，接住意思便是「得到」意思。

senses.title: To cause or persuade
senses.definition: to make someone do something or make something happen
senses.definitionCN: 使某人做某事或使某事发生
senses.example: She got her brother to fix the radio.
senses.exampleCN: 她说服哥哥修好了收音机。
senses.why: Causing moves a thing into a new state by force of will, the causative arm of the change sense.
senses.whyCN: 使役靠意志把事物推进新状态，是「变化」义的使役分支。

intro.en: Get is a native Norse-influenced verb whose Old English and Old Norse parents merged early.
intro.cn: get 是受诺斯语影响的本土动词，古英语与古诺斯语的双亲早期融合。

items.en: Old Norse geta meant to obtain, beget, and guess.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 geta 意为获得、生育、猜中。

items.en: Old English gietan meant to obtain or beget, closely parallel.
items.cn: 古英语 gietan 意为获得、生育，与之高度平行。

items.en: Middle English merged the two into one very common verb.
items.cn: 中古英语把二者融合为一个极为常用的动词。

items.en: The past participle split into got and American gotten.
items.cn: 过去分词分化为 got 与美式 gotten。

items.en: Modern English multiplied get into hundreds of phrasal verbs.
items.cn: 现代英语把 get 繁衍出数百个短语动词。

note.en: Get, got, and gotten stack three layers, and take or receive stand beside it.
note.cn: get、got、gotten 叠成三层，take 与 receive 在旁分职。

美式过去分词；与 got 分工
鹅群；拼写开头相近但词源无关

entries.definition: to get formally or with effort
entries.definitionCN: 获得；较正式，强调努力

entries.definition: to be given or delivered something
entries.definitionCN: 收到；强调被动接收
成为；覆盖 get 的变化义

normalIntro.cn: 五条基于真实用法的 get 记忆钩子。

normal.en: Get is the shortest everyday verb for hand closing on things.
normal.cn: get 是「手抓住东西」的最短日常动词。

normal.en: Got covers both past tense and British past participle.
normal.cn: got 兼任过去式与英式过去分词。

normal.en: Gotten survives mainly in American speech.
normal.cn: gotten 主要存活在美式口语中。

normal.en: Get up, get on, get off, get in: position phrases everywhere.
normal.cn: get up、get on、get off、get in：位置短语无处不在。

normal.en: Get something done means arranging for it to be done.
normal.cn: get something done 表示安排把事情办成。

abstract.en: A palm opens, closes, and something new sits in it.
abstract.cn: 掌心张开、合拢，新东西落入手中。

abstract.en: The road bends and the station appears: getting there.
abstract.cn: 道路拐弯、车站出现：get 到达。

abstract.en: A lightbulb over the head is the moment you get the idea.
abstract.cn: 头顶亮起灯泡，正是 get 到主意的瞬间。

examples.en: I got your message this morning.
examples.cn: 我今天早上收到了你的消息。

examples.en: It gets cold here after October.
examples.cn: 十月之后这里开始变冷。

examples.en: She got the window repaired before winter.
examples.cn: 入冬前她找人把窗户修好了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「盖特」——伸手一盖就特快到手。

root: 古英语 gietan（获得、生育）与古诺斯语 geta 融合 → 中古英语 getten/get → 现代 get；异干过去式 got、gotten 属本土 irregular 体系。

sensesIntro.en: The closed hand is the root; reception, becoming, arriving, understanding, and causing branch from it.
sensesIntro.cn: 合拢的手是根；接收、变化、到达、理解与使役都由它分支。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand closing on what arrives
core.cn: 核心意象：合拢的手抓住到达之物

intro.en: Get is a phrasal-verb factory, pairing with dozens of small adverbs.
intro.cn: get 是短语动词工厂，与数十个小副词搭配。

latinIntro.en: There are no Latin relatives: get is a Germanic and Norse verb.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词：get 属日耳曼与诺斯语动词。

items.example: I get up at six on schooldays.
items.exampleCN: 上学日我六点起床。

items.example: They get on well with the neighbours.
items.exampleCN: 他们与邻居相处融洽。

items.example: Get off at the third stop.
items.exampleCN: 在第三站下车。

items.example: She got in late last night.
items.exampleCN: 她昨晚到家很晚。

items.example: The cabin is their weekend getaway.
items.exampleCN: 小木屋是他们周末的避世处。

items.example: A go-getter never waits for luck.
items.exampleCN: 进取者从不等待运气。

items.example: He has gotten used to the noise.
items.exampleCN: 他已经习惯噪音了。

items.example: Old texts say pride begets ruin.
items.exampleCN: 古文称傲慢招致毁灭。

items.example: Do not forget the tickets.
items.exampleCN: 别忘了带票。
